title: Public Sector Strategic Account Executive, SLED - Mountain Plains
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><strong>An overview of this role</strong></p> <p>As a Strategic Account Leader on our Public Sector Team, you’ll help state and local agencies and higher education institutions modernize how they build and secure software using GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform in the Mountain Plains region. You’ll align GitLab with agency priorities like CI/CD automation, secure development practices, and infrastructure modernization in regulated environments, acting as the primary point of contact for strategic and large prospects. Reporting to a Regional Director, you’ll own a defined book of business, build and execute multi-year account plans, navigate complex procurement cycles, and partner closely with system integrators and resellers to deliver outcomes that matter to public sector missions.</p> <p>In your first year, you’ll focus on developing trusted relationships with CIOs, technical leaders, and key stakeholders across your territory, driving successful rollouts and adoption of GitLab, and coordinating with our pre- and post-sales engineering and support teams. You’ll also represent the voice of your customers internally by sharing product feedback and ideas through our public issue tracker, helping shape how GitLab serves the public sector over time.</p> <p><strong>This role will be remote and will be based in Colorado, Arizona, Minnesota, Utah, Nevada or Kansas.</strong></p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Build and execute strategic account plans that align GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform with public sector modernization initiatives</p> </li> <li> <p>Navigate complex procurement and contracting processes while shaping multi-year technology roadmaps with CIOs and technical leaders</p> </li> <li> <p>Act as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for strategic and large public sector prospects and customers</p> </li> <li> <p>Own your book of business, from pipeline development through close and expansion, using a consultative, mission-focused sales approach</p> </li> <li> <p>Collaborate with pre-sales and post-sales engineering, customer success, and support teams to ensure successful rollout, adoption, and value realization</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with system integrators, resellers, and other channel partners to generate qualified leads and co-create solutions for government challenges</p> </li> <li> <p>Conduct ongoing prospecting and opportunity development activities within large and strategic accounts to drive new and expansion business</p> </li> <li> <p>Represent the voice of the customer by sharing feedback and product ideas through GitLab’s public issue tracker and internal teams</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Experience selling technology solutions to U.S. State and Local Government and Higher Education institutions, including working within regulated environments</p> </li> <li> <p>Knowledge of the software development lifecycle, including CI/CD automation, secure development practices, and infrastructure modernization</p> </li> <li> <p>Understanding of State procurement vehicles, compliance requirements, and agency buying cycles, with the ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments</p> </li> <li> <p>Consultative sales approach that positions technology as a mission enabler and aligns solutions to public sector modernization initiatives</p> </li> <li> <p>Ability to manage major accounts with a high degree of ownership and control, working under minimal supervision on complex opportunities</p> </li> <li> <p>Skill in collaborating with system integrators, resellers, and internal pre- and post-sales teams to drive successful customer outcomes</p> </li> <li> <p>Effective written and verbal communication skills, with strong interpersonal abilities to build consensus across technical and non-technical stakeholders</p> </li> <li> <p>Alignment with GitLab’s values, openness to learning, and readiness to apply transferable skills and diverse experiences to the public sector domain</p> </li> <li>Willingness to travel to meet customers and attend events as needed</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Public Sector Team focuses on helping U.S. state and local governments and higher education institutions modernize how they build, secure, and operate software using GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You’ll join a distributed group of strategic account leaders, solutions architects, and channel specialists who collaborate asynchronously across time zones to serve complex, regulated customers. We partner closely with system integrators and resellers, align with agency procurement processes, and coordinate with product, marketing, and support teams to deliver secure, compliant solutions. Our current priorities include navigating evolving procurement and compliance requirements, supporting infrastructure modernization and secure development practices, and expanding GitLab’s presence across key public sector accounts.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.</em></p></div><div class="title">United States Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$122,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$205,200 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. title: Clinical Pharmacist (Independent Prescriber) at AIOS Medical- Remote, £45/hr inc equity
description: About AIOS AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor. We’re at $400M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We’re the world’s fastest growing AI doctor. We’re faithfully serving >150k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’re profitable. Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses: The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders. Our master plan: Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025 : We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market. Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026 : Over the last 12 months we've grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR. Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028 : Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider. Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2031 : Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe. Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035 : With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication. In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company. We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us. You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS Being a Clinical Pharmacist at AIOS We are building a world-class team. At AIOS Tech (Bolt Pharmacy), we're building the world's first full-stack AI doctor. Right now it's akin to assisted self-driving (and improving every day), so humans are prescribing with AI assisting their workflows. You'll join our growing team of Independent Prescribers, working through GLP-1 weight-management consultations day in, day out. You understand that a great patient experience means catching everything you need to prescribe safely and confidently first time - not sending someone back and forth for information you should have picked up on intake. You'll assess each patient on their own merits: the comorbidity, the interacting medication, the case that needs a second look, and make the right call. You’ll never compromise on safety or accuracy. You'll: Deliver safe, evidence-based GLP-1 prescribing for every patient on your list Take full ownership of the clinical quality, safety and accuracy of your own consultations and records Flag anything that needs escalating—a red flag, a near miss, a protocol gap—clearly and quickly Follow, and help sharpen, our clinical protocols as they evolve This role is suited to a confident, forward-thinking prescriber with sound clinical judgement, excellent attention to detail, and a strong commitment to patient safety. Great performance in this role means your patients are safe, your records hold up to audit, and you're working through a full, steady caseload without ever cutting corners. If you nail this role, you'll be a strong candidate for more senior clinical positions as we grow. This is an ongoing contractor engagement - full-time (40h) preferred, part-time (20h+) available - fully remote/WFH or hybrid onsite in Blackburn. You’ll report directly to your team lead. You’ll also work most closely with: Noozhat Patel (UK Clinical Operations Lead) Mobeen Nawaz (Clinical Team Lead) Adedayo Titiloye (Deputy Superintendent Pharmacist) Key Responsibilities Prescribing : Deliver safe, evidence-based GLP-1 prescribing for every patient you see — assessing suitability, comorbidities and contraindications before you write anything. Consultations : Run detailed, efficient consultations that capture everything you need the first time, so patients aren't stuck in back-and-forth messiness. Monitoring : Track treatment response and side effects across your caseload, and adjust care promptly and safely. Escalation : Recognise what's outside your remit, and escalate red flags, near misses or complex cases to your Senior Clinician Team Lead quickly and clearly. Documentation : Keep accurate, concise and contemporaneous clinical records that hold up to audit. Governance : Contribute to clinical audits, incident learning and quality improvement when asked. Collaboration : Work smoothly with customer support, operational and technology teams to keep the service safe and moving in service of our patient base. Need to Have Registration : GPhC-registered pharmacist with an Independent Prescriber (IP) annotation, held for at least 1 year. GLP-1 Confidence : You've prescribed weight-management, GLP-1s or a closely related area — comorbidities and polypharmacy don't throw you off protocol. Clinical Reasoning : You think clearly and quickly within a protocol-led service. Safety Mindset : Patient safety and quality are non-negotiable for you. Red flags don't get past you. Communication : Excellent written and verbal communication, including confident patient counselling. Pace : Comfortable in a fast-paced, high-volume, protocol-led environment, and you don't let volume compromise accuracy. Digital Literacy : Confident using electronic health records and remote consultation platforms. Flexibility : Willing to support evening or weekend rotas when needed. With sufficient notice, you work the hours that our patients need you to work so they can be served without long wait times and unnecessary friction. Nice to Have Consultation Modes : Experience with asynchronous, telephone and/or video consultations. Specialist Training : Additional training in obesity or weight management, such as SCOPE certification. Postgraduate : A postgraduate clinical diploma or equivalent. Complex Patients : Comfortable managing patients with diabetes, cardiovascular disease, renal impairment or polypharmacy. Governance Experience : Some experience contributing to clinical audits, incident investigations or quality-improvement projects. Protocols : Exposure to developing SOPs, clinical protocols or prescribing pathways. Startup Pace : Experience working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, ideally in the weight loss space. Growth Mindset : An interest in eventually mentoring or supporting more junior colleagues as you grow with us. Systems : Familiarity with clinical support and customer management systems. 🎯 “You just build a f* ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take.” Training and onboarding Training is delivered completely remotely The duration of training is a minimum of 2 days , with scheduling negotiable depending on experience and prior exposure to GLP-1 prescribing or digital health services. Ongoing mentoring and support are provided throughout your induction and practice. Following successful completion of the training period, the role transitions to remote working. Compensation & Benefits You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this. Compensation : £45/hr inc equity Benefits The stuff below is cool as well: Personal development : budget for books, courses, coaching Personal wellness : budget for gym, health apps Coaching : free biweekly health coaching Equipment : Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: iOS Developer (Radiotech)
description: About us Gismart is a value-driven mobile app developer with a strong presence in the Health & Wellness, Utilities, and Music app markets. We have recently reached an important milestone of 1B+ downloads worldwide , moving closer to our mission of supporting people on their self-improvement journeys. Headquartered in London, Gismart is a global company with a team of 400+ people across Europe and beyond . We bring together professionals from entertainment, music, and tech backgrounds, combining creativity, product thinking, and strong execution to build apps used by millions of people worldwide. Our mission is to become a stepping stone on our customers’ journeys of self-improvement. Our values Deliver what matters Respect and support others Initiate and own Voice openly Execute with quality If you are passionate about mobile products and want to work on apps with real scale, Gismart is the right place to grow, take ownership, and make an impact. About the project At Radiotech , we believe music belongs to everyone - not just those who grew up taking lessons. As a product company inside the Gismart ecosystem, we've spent years building apps that make music feel approachable, fun, and deeply human. With 23 apps across iOS and Android and over 500 million downloads worldwide, our products have found their way into the hands of musicians, beginners, and curious souls across the globe. We see music as a universal language. Our job is to make sure more people can speak it. Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and modernize existing iOS applications using Swift, SwiftUI, and UIKit. Define and evolve the architecture of the iOS codebase with a focus on scalability, modularization, and maintainability. Design and implement efficient, testable technical solutions. Prepare existing applications for gradual adoption of Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP). Participate in the migration of selected business logic and shared components to KMP. Collaborate with Android and other engineers on shared mobile architecture and APIs. Research technical challenges and propose appropriate architectural solutions. Troubleshoot complex issues and optimize application performance and memory usage. Perform code reviews and contribute to technical documentation. Maintain and improve CI/CD and release workflows. Collaborate with Product Managers on technical solutions, planning, and estimation. Proactively suggest technical and product improvements. Use AI coding tools and engineering agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar as part of the regular development workflow. Requirements 4+ years of professional iOS development experience. Strong proficiency in Swift and modern language features. Strong experience with Swift Concurrency (async/await) and reactive programming such as Combine. Production experience with both SwiftUI and UIKit. Strong understanding of iOS architecture, application lifecycle, and platform frameworks. Experience with MVVM, Clean Architecture, modular architecture, and reusable components. Ability to independently design and implement complex technical solutions. Experience with REST APIs, GraphQL, asynchronous networking, and multithreading. Familiarity with Xcode, Instruments, SPM, CocoaPods, and Fastlane. Understanding of App Store submission, signing, provisioning, TestFlight, and release management. Experience with feature flags, remote configuration, and A/B testing. Experience with CI/CD and automated testing. Practical experience using AI coding assistants and engineering agents in daily development. Employee Benefits Remote-First Culture: Our team is diverse and extensive, just like our product portfolio. We provide a flexible working schedule and let you work anywhere in the world, either remotely or in one of our corporate hubs. Сoworking Compensation: We provide 100% compensation for coworking spaces in Ukraine (except Kyiv, where we have a cozy and autonomous hub) and 50% compensation for coworking spaces worldwide to make sure that everyone has a comfortable and inspiring workspace. Free Office Lunches: We want you to stay fueled and focused, so we provide delicious free lunches for everyone working from our hubs. It’s one less thing for you to worry about during a productive workday. Public Holidays Policy: Gismart observes public holidays based on the Ukrainian or Polish holiday calendars. Employees working in other locations are entitled to 12 public holidays per year. 100% Sick Leave Compensation Mental and Physical Health: To help you stay happy and healthy, Gismart will partially cover your medical insurance, sports activities, therapy costs. Personal Equipment Policy: Of course, we’ll provide you with all the equipment you need or cover the maintenance cost for your own tools. Personal Learning and Development: We love to see you learn and grow, so Gismart will cover 70% of your professional development courses. We’ll also pay for 100% of corporate English courses. Time-Off Policy: Every employee gets 18 working days of paid vacation and 3 personal days per year, with an extra day added for each year at Gismart. Corporate Events: We are remote-first, but we love meeting up in person. Whenever possible, we organize corporate events and team-building activities across all Gismart hubs. description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: The People Team at Notion exists to help build a generational company - one that enables people to do their best and most meaningful work. Hiring exceptional talent, at the right time and with care, is central to that mission. We’re looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to partner closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to create a thoughtful, well-run, and genuinely human candidate experience. This role sits at the center of our hiring process and plays an important role in how candidates experience Notion. This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. About the role We're hiring a Direct Tax Lead to own our US income tax provision, compliance, and controls, reporting to the Head of Tax. ElevenLabs operates through its US entity and ~9 international entities and is growing fast, which means the provision, the compliance calendar, and the controls around them need a dedicated owner. This is a hands-on ownership role. The provision and returns are prepared by external providers; you manage those engagements and are accountable for the output. You'll own the quarterly and annual ASC 740 provision (deferreds, valuation allowance, uncertain tax positions, rate rec, footnote disclosures), the US federal and state compliance calendar (returns, extensions, estimated payments), and the technical work underneath it: §174 capitalization, §382 and NOL tracking. You'll also assist in designing, documenting, and operating controls, and write the memos that support our positions, working directly with our Big 4 advisors and external auditors alongside the Head of Tax. Requirements Deep ASC 740 expertise at a multinational — provision, deferreds, valuation allowance, uncertain tax positions, rate reconciliation, and footnote disclosure Experience owning a US federal and multistate compliance calendar (returns, extensions, estimates) Working knowledge of US international provisions (NCTI/GILTI, Subpart F, FDDEI, §163(j)) and how they flow into the provision Experience managing Big 4 or equivalent providers and working directly with external auditors Has built or operated SOX controls over tax, or supported a first SOX implementation CPA Bonus: pre-IPO or first-10-K experience, §174/§41 computation, §382 studies, equity compensation tax (ISOs, NSOs, RSUs), OneSource Tax Provision or similar. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role: Build and lead the direct tax team as we bring provision and compliance in-house Expand into other strategic initiatives such as M&A, PE mitigation policy, corporate structuring. Broaden into wider tax leadership as our footprint grows Location This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere on the east coast, New York preferred. title: Ubuntu Linux Kernel Engineer - Silicon Enablement
description: <p>Ubuntu Linux is already the most popular Linux distribution in the world, and its mission is to remain at the forefront of the global software ecosystem. As the industry evolves, we are expanding our support for a wider array of System on Chip (SoC) platforms to ensure that every user receives a high-performance and reliable experience. There is growing and vital demand from major silicon manufacturers such as NVIDIA, AMD, Qualcomm, MediaTek, and Renesas to provide Ubuntu Linux as the foundational platform for their next-generation hardware.</p> <p>The Canonical Kernel Team is responsible for the build, maintenance, and distribution of the Linux kernel for Ubuntu. We are looking for engineers who share our passion for building high-quality, robust software foundations that others can rely upon. This role sits at a critical junction in the software stack, ensuring that the underlying hardware is seamlessly integrated, optimized and prepared to meet the demands of modern computing.</p> <p>While direct experience with the Linux kernel would be an advantage, it is not a hard requirement. Candidates with RTOS or bare-metal experience and demonstrable hardware experience are encouraged to apply.</p> <p>We welcome applications from engineers at various stages of their careers, from those beginning their journey in hardware-level development to seasoned industry veterans.</p> <h2><strong>Location</strong></h2> <p>This is a globally remote role.</p> <h2><strong>What the role entails</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Drive the integration of platform support from our silicon partners into the Ubuntu Linux kernel</li> <li>Lead the identification and resolution of complex kernel issues reported by partners, customers, or discovered through rigorous testing</li> <li>Own the delivery of distinct, silicon-optimized variants of the Ubuntu Linux kernel to the global community</li> <li>Develop and refine the tooling and automation required for the reliable delivery and testing of our kernels</li> <li>Manage the submission and review process for upstream patches, collaborating effectively with both internal and external maintainers</li> <li>Identify new methodologies and strategies for maximizing performance on partner silicon</li> <li>Collaborate proactively within a globally distributed engineering team to ensure cohesive outcomes across the organization</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Proficiency in C programming, particularly for low-level system development</li> <li>A strong grasp of device drivers, BSPs, and other aspects of hardware-level system engineering</li> <li>Deep understanding of operating system kernel fundamentals</li> <li>Professional proficiency with Git for version control and collaborative development</li> <li>Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and verbal, within a professional context</li> <li>A professional approach to collaborating with business partners and the open-source community</li> <li>Ability to travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks in length</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience with Python or Bash scripting for automation and tooling</li> <li>Prior experience working with major SoC families (e.g., NVIDIA, Intel, AMD, Qualcomm, MediaTek, Renesas)</li> <li>Familiarity with Ubuntu, Debian, or Snap packaging</li> <li>Demonstrated expertise in Linux kernel patching and debugging</li> <li>A deep understanding of performance optimization techniques for silicon platforms</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer you</strong></h2> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Home-based work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About Canonical</strong></h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h2><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></h2> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. </p> <p><a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-remote</p>

title: Business Analyst KI-Prozessautomatisierung (m/w/d)
description: Wir bei KnowWay entwickeln KI-Agenten für kritische Infrastruktur – Energie, Telekommunikation und öffentlicher Sektor. Überall dort, wo Compliance, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Datensouveränität keine Kompromisse zulassen, automatisieren wir Geschäftsprozesse mit KI. Dabei begleiten wir unsere Kunden über den gesamten Daten- und KI-Lebenszyklus: von Daten und Datenqualität über KI-Verarbeitung bis zur Integration in produktive Systeme. Das Projekt Für einen führenden Telekommunikationskonzern in Deutschland setzen wir Daten- und KI-Projekte auf der Google Cloud um. Mehrere Anwendungsfälle laufen parallel – von Discovery und Business Analyse über PoCs und Entwicklung bis zum Live-Betrieb. Die Prozesse, die wir automatisieren, sind oft über Jahre gewachsen. Wissen steckt in einzelnen Köpfen, Abläufe sind nur teilweise dokumentiert und Fachbereiche arbeiten mit selbst entwickelten Excel-, Access-, SharePoint- oder anderen Legacy-Lösungen. Genau dort setzt Deine Rolle an. Aufgaben Die Rolle Du verstehst, was im Fachbereich wirklich passiert – und bereitest es so auf, dass daraus ein umsetzbarer Daten- oder KI-Anwendungsfall entsteht. Dafür arbeitest Du direkt mit Sachbearbeiter, Projektleitungen und Entscheider. Du findest heraus, wo das eigentliche Problem liegt, welche Regeln tatsächlich gelten und wie ein Prozess funktioniert. Du modellierst Abläufe und Entscheidungslogiken und machst sie für unser Delivery-Team nutzbar. Dabei gehst Du über klassische Business Analyse hinaus: Du arbeitest heraus, auf welchen Daten ein Prozess basiert, welche Objekte und Beziehungen existieren, aus welchen Systemen die Daten stammen und was in den einzelnen Verarbeitungsschritten mit ihnen passiert. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Solution Architect sowie unseren Data-, AI- und Software-Engineers zusammen. Du musst keine Datenpipeline bauen und keinen produktiven Code schreiben. Du solltest aber Datenflüsse verstehen und einschätzen können, was technisch möglich ist – und was das für den Fachbereich bedeutet. description: We are looking for a Chief of Staff–style operator to serve as the President’s right hand and help run, maintain, and continuously evolve the Product, Engineering & Design operating model and cadence. This role will turn strategy into a durable execution system. You will own the connective tissue across the President’s leadership cadence: preparing the right inputs, creating clarity on decisions and tradeoffs, ensuring commitments are followed through, surfacing risks early, and improving the operating model as the organization changes. You will work across Product, Engineering, Design, Commercial, Finance, People, and your peers in Business Operations, partnering with senior leaders who do not report to you and influencing through judgment, trust, and clarity. The successful candidate will combine executive judgment, operational rigor, business acumen, comfort with ambiguity, strong written and verbal communication, and the ability to move fluidly between strategic questions and the execution details required to make the system work. AI fluency is an important part of this role. You will use approved enterprise AI tools, including tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Glean, Cursor, or comparable platforms, to automate repeatable operating work, synthesize information across functions, improve leadership preparation, surface risks and dependencies, and accelerate strategic-initiative delivery. Own end-to-end orchestration of the leadership rhythm: staff meetings, WBRs, MBRs, and QBRs, finance and portfolio reviews, priority updates, and annual operating-plan inputs. Ensure each ritual has a clear purpose, owner, input, output, decision authority, and downstream cascade. Drive decision quality. Synthesize diverse inputs into concise narratives that make priorities, risks, options, tradeoffs, and recommended decisions clear to the President and leadership team. Document decisions in the room, assign owners and deadlines, track commitments, and escalate unresolved issues with context and a proposed path forward. Improve execution velocity. Identify alignment and execution risks before they surface as leadership surprises, and facilitate resolution across Product, Engineering, Design, Commercial, Customer Operations, Finance, People, and Business Operations, connecting planning, performance, financial, organizational, and roadmap inputs. Use AI and advanced tooling to make decisions faster and better-informed. Evolve the operating model. Treat the operating system as a living thing. Establish health measures such as decision latency, action closure, cascade reach, pre-read quality, participation, recurring issue themes, and use them to assess whether rituals, artifacts, and escalation paths are producing the right outcomes. Recommend and implement changes to cadence, governance, templates, roles, and channels as strategy and priorities evolve, codifying what works so the model is easy for leaders to understand and operate. Lead high-priority strategic initiatives. Drive complex, ambiguous, cross-functional work on behalf of the President, from framing and workplan through decision, implementation, and follow-through, including emerging problems that don't yet have a clear owner. Support annual strategy, goals, headcount, and budget processes by connecting them to the department's operating rhythm. Represent the President and build transparency. Stand in for the President in meetings, events, and discussions, exercising the remit of the position. Navigate difficult conversations and cross-functional tradeoffs without relying on formal authority. Support two-way access to the President through Town Halls, Roundtables, Office Hours, and written follow-up, using sound judgment about what should be broadly communicated, selectively shared, or handled privately. Serve as a trusted thought partner to the President and senior leadership team, offering an independent perspective and respectfully challenging assumptions when needed. Who We’re Looking For Significant experience in Chief of Staff, Product Operations, Business Operations, Strategy & Operations, or management consulting A track record of owning an operating model, leadership cadence, or portfolio of complex cross-functional initiatives, preferably in tech companies Knowledge of the product / software development lifecycle Demonstrated proficiency with enterprise AI tools, such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Glean, Cursor, or comparable approved tools, and experience integrating them into daily workflows to automate repeatable tasks, optimize processes, improve synthesis, and accelerate project delivery. Exceptional written communication: you can turn a large volume of input into a concise, decision-ready narrative tailored to the audience Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to understand metrics, forecasts, resource tradeoffs, product or portfolio performance, and organizational implications. Strong executive presence and facilitation skills; you can create clarity and momentum in high-stakes or ambiguous settings. Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, build consensus, resolve conflict, and push for decisions without formal authority. High judgment and discretion when handling sensitive organizational, people, financial, and strategic information. Comfort operating in ambiguity, switching between strategic altitude and detailed execution, and taking ownership of problems that cross organizational boundaries. A continuous-improvement mindset: you distinguish between process and content, challenge ineffective routines, and make change practical and durable. A bias toward action, paired with the judgment to know when to decide, when to seek input, and when to escalate. What Success Looks Like In the first 6–12 months, you will: Implement a dependable operating rhythm in which leadership forums are well-prepared, decision-oriented, and followed through. Improve the quality and consistency of pre-reads, decision logs, action tracking, portfolio updates, and quarterly communications. Make it easy to see what changed, what matters now, what decisions are needed, who owns the next step, and where risk is accumulating. Establish a small number of reliable AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual preparation and reporting effort, improve the timeliness and quality of leadership inputs, and make follow-through more visible. Increase the organization’s ability to reuse knowledge, detect recurring issues, and move from raw information to clear decisions without adding unnecessary process. Build strong working relationships and trust with the President and his leaders across the department and company, leading with tact, discretion and respect. Help the President and leadership team make faster, clearer, better-informed decisions without adding unnecessary processes or meetings. Leave the system more scalable and more resilient than you found it. title: Global Director - General Ledger
description: Are You Ready? CAI is a professional services company established in 1996 that has grown year over year to nearly 800 people worldwide. For mission-critical and regulated industries that need to deliver critical solutions in high-stakes environments, we provide accelerated operational readiness and unparalleled performance at the highest standard through our rigorous approach, field-tested processes, and elite expertise developed over 30 years. Our approach is simple because our Purpose informs everything we do: We exist to be the trusted solution for our clients as they strive to build a better working world and improve the human experience. Our Foundational Principles: We act with integrity We serve each other We serve society We work for our future At CAI, we believe in a relentless dedication to excellence, pushing boundaries and surpassing expectations. From the beginning, we’ve challenged ourselves to do what others wouldn’t. Not just setting industry standards, but redefining them entirely. We are bold in our thinking and creative in our approach. We operate at the intersection of wisdom and technology and thrive when they come together with humanity. For us, operational readiness isn’t simply a goal—it’s a way of life. Tomorrow demands to be at the forefront of today. We get there through tireless effort, precision, efficiency, and an unwavering belief that there is always room for advancement. We’re not interested in how it used to be done. We’re obsessed with how it will be done. The Global Director, General Ledger leads the global Record-to-Report process and is responsible for the monthly close and year end close, journal entry governance, balance sheet reconciliations, consolidation support, intercompany accounting, fixed asset accounting, account structure governance, close controls, and GL integration for acquired companies. This role ensures that the company’s books are complete, accurate, timely, and consistently maintained across all legal entities and countries. Key Responsibilities: Own the global Record-to-Report process, including close calendar management, journal entry standards, account reconciliations, accruals, allocations, intercompany accounting, fixed assets, and consolidation support. Establish global GL policies, procedures, account ownership standards, reconciliation templates, close checklists, certification requirements, and quality review routines. Provide technical accounting expertise on the interpretation and application of accounting standards, monitor changes in accounting standards and reporting requirements, and ensure relevant changes are appropriately implemented across the organization Lead monthly and annual close execution across countries, shared services, and local finance teams, ensuring deadlines, review standards, issue escalation, and reporting dependencies are met. Maintain governance over the chart of accounts, legal entity structure, department and practice coding, cost centers, intercompany accounts, and reporting attributes. Partner with FP&A to ensure actual results are reported in ways that support management reporting, KPI analysis, profitability views, and decision support. Partner with the Tax & Audit to support compliance requirements and audit activities by ensuring accurate and timely financial information, reconciliations and supporting schedules are available Support acquisition integration by mapping acquired company ledgers, converting chart of accounts, opening balance sheet support, standardizing close processes, and aligning accounting policies. Strengthen controls over manual journals, reconciliations, account ownership, recurring entries, intercompany settlements, fixed assets, accruals, and close certifications. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance required; CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, CMA, or equivalent preferred. 8+ years of accounting, general ledger, controllership, consolidation, or record-to-report experience, including leadership in a multi-entity or multi-country environment. Strong technical accounting knowledge and experience applying accounting standards to complex or non-routine transactions is preferred. Experience with ERP systems, close management tools, multi-currency accounting, intercompany processes, acquisition integration, and internal controls is preferred. #LI-MV1 Compensation Average base salary range - not including benefits. Additional Information We are an equal opportunity employer; we are proud to employ veterans and promote diversity and inclusion in our workplace. Diversity is a strength for our global company. We pledge that CAI will be operated in a way that is fair and equitable to all – our employees, our customers, and the broader society. This job description is not all inclusive and you may be asked to do other duties. CAI will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Fair Chance Act (FCA) / Fair Chance Ordinance (FCO).

systems with clear performance and security trade-offs.</strong><strong>Hands-on experience deploying and managing infrastructure in cloud providers and on-premises environments, including using tools testing and code review.</strong><strong>Experience performing migrations to GitLab, including using Congregate or similar migration tooling.</strong><strong>Working knowledge of data consistency and title: Strategic WFM Analyst
description: About Clipboard Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S. Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities. Role Overview The Strategic WFM Analyst lives in the Core Workforce Management (WFM) Planning & Operations Strategy team and is responsible for owning centralized forecast, capacity planning, workforce cost optimization, and strategic headcount trade-offs across all lines of business (LOBs). Moving beyond traditional scheduling and intraday monitoring, this role acts as a high-judgment governance function, translating complex demand forecasts into defensible FTE, BPO, and overtime spend strategies, modeling capacity risks, and aligning executive stakeholders across Finance, Product, and Operations. You are exceptionally strong in WFM math and financial analytics, exhibit deep strategic curiosity, navigate messy raw data effortlessly, and communicate recommendations with executive-level clarity. What You’ll Do Translating multi-LOB demand forecasts into monthly and quarterly capacity, headcount, and budget requirements. Modeling workforce and financial trade-offs across internal FTEs, BPO partners, overtime spend, bonus hours, productivity shifts, and shrinkage. Analyzing demand-funnel changes (e.g., product feature rollouts, AI bot deflection shifts) and quantifying their exact capacity and dollar blast radius. Partnering directly with Finance, Product, and Operations to validate baseline assumptions, enforce input SLAs, and align on staffing commitments. Drafting concise, decision-ready executive memos and Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs) for Directors and leadership. Conducting deep-dive root-cause analyses whenever operational actuals deviate from capacity plans and establishing corrective action paths. Standardizing capacity planning frameworks, modeling templates, and operating standards across LOBs. Maintaining deep forecasting competency to audit models, challenge underlying assumptions, and provide seamless coverage across the broader central WFM engine. What We’re Looking For Strategic WFM Math: Exceptionally strong quantitative background with deep expertise in WFM fundamentals (capacity modeling, Erlang, shrinkage, AHT, SLA/ASA trade-offs) and advanced proficiency in Google Sheets, SQL, or Python. Business & Financial Judgment: Demonstrated ability to connect operational queue dynamics directly to dollar exposure, hiring velocity, BPO costs, and SLA risk. Executive Communication: Superior strategic writing skills with a natural instinct to distill complex, multi-variable workforce analytics into scannable, 1-2 page decision memos. Cross-Functional Influence: Proven ability to establish governance frameworks, challenge bad assumptions with backtested data, and align Finance, Product, and Operations leadership without formal authority. Blank-Page Ownership: High comfort operating in ambiguous environments with incomplete data, verifiably isolating what materially matters without requiring step-by-step direction. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>The Trusted Agentic Development team sits within GitLab's Developer Experience group and builds the platforms our engineers rely on every day. GitLab engineers increasingly build software with artificial intelligence agents. Agents can generate code and tests in seconds, but they can also produce passing test suites for software that doesn't work as intended. As a Senior Backend Engineer, Trusted Agentic Development, you'll own the technical thesis for closing that validation gap and build the early proof yourself. You'll rethink what validation means when the author is an agent and make the feedback loop fast, automatic, and trustworthy enough that teams choose to adopt it.</p> <ul> <li value="1">Validation that confirms agent-generated code does what was intended, so a passing suite means a working feature and not just a satisfied proxy.</li> <li value="2">Mid-loop feedback that helps an agent self-correct toward working software instead of green assertions.</li> <li value="3">Language-aware approaches under one shared model of what "trusted" means, starting with Rust, Ruby, and Go, while allowing the right technique to differ by language.</li> <li value="4">Real measurement of whether engineers trust and adopt the path, fed straight back into the platform.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Own the technical thesis for how GitLab validates software when an agent is the author, and turn it into an architecture the team can build against.</li> <li value="2">Prototype the hard parts by building early versions of feedback mechanisms that catch the gap between passing tests and working software, proving what works before the team scales it.</li> <li value="3">Develop approaches for GitLab's primary stacks, starting with Rust, Ruby, and Go, under one shared definition of "trusted," while allowing the right technique to differ by language.</li> <li value="4">Design the mid-loop feedback an agent needs to self-correct toward working software rather than green assertions, and build the systems that deliver it.</li> <li value="5">Collaborate with engineering teams to adopt these approaches, measure adoption, engineer trust, and validation quality, and use those findings to improve the platform.</li> <li value="6">Set technical direction the team can build on, review designs, and help teammates grow their technical judgment.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Deep, current, hands-on experience building real software with artificial intelligence agents, ideally across more than one language, and a clear understanding of why agent output can pass tests yet fail in production.</li> <li value="2">A strong point of view on the validation gap and concrete ideas for closing it, backed by approaches you've built or tried.</li> <li value="3">Experience designing distributed systems designed to run on Kubernetes first.</li> <li value="3">The technical range to design systems rather than tune a single framework, and the judgment to know when a solution should be general or language-specific.</li> <li value="4">You prototype to learn, and you ship.</li> <li value="5">The ability to influence engineers across an organization without formal authority through working code and sound reasoning.</li> <li value="6">Strong written communication in an all-remote, asynchronous environment.</li> <li value="7">Alignment with GitLab's values, especially collaboration, iteration, and transparency.</li> </ul> <p>This isn't a quality assurance or test automation role. title: Consultant Neurologist PAYE
description: Our patients have often tried everything. Years of appointments, medications that did not work, conditions that slowly took over their lives. By the time they reach us, many have run out of road with conventional treatment. You could be the clinician that changes that. We are Montu UK , one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultant Neurologists to join our clinical team. About the role You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical call on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is still a young field. The evidence base is growing, best practice is being written in real time, and you will have a genuine hand in shaping it. You do not need experience with cannabis based medicines. You need sound clinical judgement, an open mind and an interest in doing things differently. We provide full specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up tasks, so your time is spent where it matters: with patients. What you will be doing: Providing high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment Conducting patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management Contributing to clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practice Supporting clinical governance and maintaining robust standards of patient care Working closely within a multidisciplinary team of nurses and pharmacists Taking part in ongoing training and development, including bespoke specialist training in cannabis based medicines (CBPMs) What you need: Full GMC Registration Completion of Specialist Training (CCST/CCT) or equivalent certification On the GMC Specialist Register for Neurology A genuine interest in alternative therapies Willingness to participate in data collection and reporting Why join us? Highly competitive salary Flexible working with full time or part time options Comprehensive indemnity coverage. Montu covers all professional and clinical indemnity insurance for your work with us Private healthcare scheme No night shifts and no on call CPD accredited medical cannabis education and specialist in house training from industry leaders A collaborative multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals The chance to be part of a pioneering field and shape the future of medical cannabis care in the UK Training and development: Attendance at a recognised Medical Cannabis Course for Specialist Physicians, sponsored by Montu Specialist training delivered by experts Ongoing support on clinical protocols, prescribing practices and Montu's systems Working arrangements: Fully remote with flexible working hours and days Standard sessions are 4 hours of patient consultations, and you choose your preferred days and hours To support onboarding, we ask for a minimum commitment of 2 sessions per week (8 hours) initially, so you become confident with our platform Appointments are 15 minutes for new and existing patients. Our multidisciplinary model means nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up prescribing tasks, so Consultants focus on prescribing and patient care About Montu Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis based medicines. We exist to transform lives by improving access to safe, effective treatment and delivering an exceptional standard of care. We move quickly, we care deeply about our patients, and we are building something that did not exist in UK healthcare five years ago. If that sounds like your kind of place, we would love to hear from you.

title: VP, GTM Strategy & Systems
description: What is Contentstack ? Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system. While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time. Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program. Learn more at www.contentstack.com . Who Are We? At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let’s go! What Are We Looking For? We are seeking an experienced and strategic VP, GTM Strategy & Systems to own Contentstack’s AI-native go-to-market operating system end to end. Reporting directly to the CEO, this role will partner closely with the CRO, CMO, and CFO to translate growth strategy into the data, systems, workflows, and AI-augmented processes that power our go-to-market organization. This is a senior executive leadership role with ownership across three pillars: GTM Ops & Analytics, GTM Engineering, and GTM Apps. You’ll be responsible for building the infrastructure that allows our GTM organization to scale more efficiently, improve decision-making, and leverage AI without simply adding headcount. Contentstack is an AI-forward company, and we believe foundation comes before automation. You’ll help establish the clean data, documented processes, clear ownership, and governance required to move our GTM organization from humans doing the work, to humans overseeing AI-powered systems that can operate at scale. If you’re excited about building an AI-native GTM operating system and shaping how a growing enterprise SaaS company scales from ~$100M to $250M ARR, we’d love to hear from you! Here’s what you’ll be doing: Own the GTM operating system across GTM Ops & Analytics, GTM Engineering, and GTM Apps, ensuring our people, processes, data, and technology work together as one system. Lead revenue, marketing, and partner operations, including pipeline, forecasting, territory and quota planning, deal desk, renewals, services, funnel operations, lead routing, attribution, partner pipeline, and GTM performance reporting. Build and evolve our GTM architecture, including process design, operating cadence, web and GTM infrastructure, and the AI/agent layer that runs across it. Own the GTM technology ecosystem, including Salesforce, CPQ, marketing automation, integrations, APIs, MCP surfaces, permissions, and governance, ensuring our systems function as a coherent platform rather than disconnected tools. Partner with AI and Engineering to identify, prioritize, and deploy high-impact agent and workflow automation use cases across the revenue funnel. Build and lead the GTM Systems organization, including pillar leads and teams across architecture/engineering, applications, and operations/analytics, while establishing clear governance and accountability across functions. Establish the GTM data foundation and operating cadence, creating shared definitions, clean data, trusted reporting, and a consistent rhythm for pipeline, forecasting, and business reviews. Drive measurable GTM efficiency, using AI, automation, and better systems to increase organizational capacity without scaling headcount in lockstep with revenue. What Really Gets Us Excited About You? 12+ years of experience across GTM functions within enterprise SaaS, including experience navigating hypergrowth, transformation, and scaling operating discipline. Proven experience building and owning GTM systems, data architecture, and operating infrastructure, rather than simply consuming reports or managing an inherited process. Hands-on AI and automation experience in a GTM environment, including deploying agents or automated workflows and understanding governance, permissions, auditability, and data quality. Deep expertise in the modern GTM technology stack, particularly Salesforce and its ecosystem, along with pipeline management, forecasting, revenue operations, and GTM analytics. Experience building teams and operating capabilities from the ground up, including diagnosing gaps, defining the architecture, and making thoughtful hiring and investment decisions. Strong ability to operate as both a hands-on builder and executive strategist, moving comfortably from stakeholder interviews and process diagnostics to architecture, prioritization, and organizational decisions. Exceptional executive presence and cross-functional influence, with the ability to drive adoption, establish governance, and create alignment across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Services, Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Finance, and the CEO’s Office. You’re comfortable making clear trade-offs and setting boundaries, knowing what belongs within GTM Systems and where ownership should remain with other functions. You like occasional travel. You value a collaborative, innovative, and fun culture and are excited about helping define what an AI-native go-to-market organization can look like in practice. Salary for this role ranges between $275,000-300,000 based on skill set and experience What Do We Offer? Interesting Work | We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the “challenge yourself” role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you’re doing it. Tribe Vibe | We are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. We have a strict “no a**hole policy” and enforce it diligently. This means we spend time together - with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected. Bragging Rights | We are dreamers and dream makers. Our efforts pay off and we work with the most prestigious brands, from big-name retailers to airlines, to professional sports teams. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more! One Team One Dream | This is one of our values, and it shows. We don’t believe in artificial hierarchies. If you’re part of the tribe, you have an opportunity to contribute. Your voice will be heard and you will also receive regular updates about the business and its performance. Which, btw, is through the roof, so it’s a great time to be joining… To review our Privacy Policy, please click here .

title: Senior Proposal Manager
description: D2L is a cloud company that is modernizing education and building the Future of Work. The old models of teaching and learning are in the midst of the largest transformation in history, and D2L is at the heart of that fundamental shift. New models of teaching and learning enable a personalized, student-centric experience – and deliver improved retention, engagement, satisfaction, and results for learners of all ages – in schools, campuses, and companies. D2L is disrupting the way the world learns, by providing the next generation learning environment and solutions to engage and inspire learners. And most importantly, by giving customers a platform that is easy, flexible, and smart. No other company provides a solution as robust and innovative as D2L. D2L has had a singular mission for 25 years and is dedicated to that same mission in the years ahead: to transform the way the world learns – and by doing so, we will help improve human potential globally. Every application we receive is personally reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team - yes, a real person looks at your resume! While we use AI tools internally to streamline tasks like meeting notes, summaries, and administrative work, these tools never rank resumes, make hiring decisions, or influence candidate evaluations. As a Senior Proposal Manager, you will work in a high-impact, fast-paced, deadline-driven environment and be responsible for leading complex proposal response efforts for prospective and existing customers globally. You will manage highly visible and strategic Requests for Proposals (e.g., RFIs, RFPs, RFQs), driving cross-functional collaboration, pursuit readiness, proposal quality, and strategic alignment throughout the proposal lifecycle. This role requires advanced communication, writing, organizational, strategic thinking, and project management skills, along with the ability to influence stakeholders, navigate ambiguity, and lead complex pursuits under pressure. Successful candidates will demonstrate strong business judgment, proposal management expertise, competitive awareness, and the ability to act as a trusted advisor and mentor within the Proposal Management team. You will play a key role in supporting proposal effectiveness, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across the function. How Will I Make an Impact?: Strategic Pursuit Leadership Lead the end-to-end management of complex, high-impact proposal responses (e.g., RFIs, RFPs, RFQs) supporting prospective and existing clients globally. Facilitate and drive complex bid qualification discussions, supporting informed pursuit decisions, proposal readiness, and strategic alignment. Lead proposal planning activities including timelines, stakeholder coordination, risk identification, escalation management, and management of cross-functional contributors. Independently manage multiple complex proposal pursuits simultaneously within fast-paced, deadline-driven environments. Apply strategic thinking, competitive awareness, and proposal management expertise to support compelling, differentiated, and high-quality proposal responses. Support proposal strategy discussions and contribute recommendations related to pursuit approach, messaging, competitiveness, and proposal effectiveness. Provide leadership guidance and influence across project teams to support strong pursuit execution, stakeholder alignment, and proposal quality outcomes. Identify opportunities to improve proposal processes, pursuit effectiveness, and operational approaches based on lessons learned and evolving business needs. Proposal Development & Strategic Communication Lead the development, writing, editing, and refinement of proposal responses to ensure submissions are compliant, strategically aligned, compelling, and error-free. Review and provide guidance on executive summaries, cover letters, messaging approaches, and other critical proposal components. Work cross-functionally with Subject Matter Experts and senior stakeholders to coordinate and enhance proposal responses while maintaining a strong understanding of D2L’s products, services, value propositions, and competitive positioning. Apply proposal management best practices, strong business judgment, and audience awareness to support high-quality and differentiated proposal responses. Ensure proposal submissions align to established brand, messaging, and style standards while adapting approaches to suit varying audiences, opportunity types, and pursuit complexity. Facilitate proposal reviews and support alignment on proposal messaging, positioning, and response strategy. Operational Excellence & Team Influence Build strong partnerships with Sales, Solution Engineering, Services, Finance, Legal, Security, Marketing, and other stakeholders involved in proposal pursuits. Act as a trusted advisor and experienced resource within the Proposal Management team, sharing expertise, supporting onboarding activities, and mentoring team members on proposal best practices and complex pursuits. Contribute to operational improvements, proposal management best practices, content enhancements, and scalable proposal management approaches. Support knowledge sharing initiatives and contribute to continuous improvement efforts across proposal operations and team effectiveness. Leverage proposal tools, AI-enabled technologies, operational processes, and proposal management best practices to support proposal quality, operational efficiency, and pursuit effectiveness. Contribute positively to a collaborative, high-performing, and solutions-oriented team environment while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence. What you’ll bring to the role: 7+ years experience in a similar role in a fast-paced, high volume proposal writing environment. Direct experience in high-tech industry is preferred. A work ethic that thrives in a fast-paced, high volume proposal writing environment. Strong writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with the ability to develop compelling, strategically aligned, audience-focused proposal responses and executive-level communications. Proven ability to develop processes and content to support new business areas and growth. APMP (Association of Proposal Management Professionals) certification or equivalent. Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, Salesforce, Adobe applications, and proposal automation software. Demonstrated ability to apply and promote AI-enabled tools and evolving proposal management best practices to improve proposal quality, team effectiveness, operational efficiency, and pursuit outcomes. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Ability to adhere to strict deadlines Experience writing proposals for education or other key verticals an asset. Education Recommendations: Bachelor’s Degree preferably in Business, Technical Writing, English, Communications, or Journalism This posting is for an existing vacancy The expected base salary range for a new hire in this role is listed below. The annualized base salary offered is determined by each candidate’s relevant knowledge, skills, education, training and experience. It is aligned to ensure both internal and external competitiveness using market data for the geographic location and industry. As part of the total compensation at D2L the role may be eligible for additional benefits including a Wellness Subsidy, Equity Grants, Variable Incentive, and more. Base Salary Range $102,500—$120,000 CAD Don’t meet every single requirement? We strongly encourage you to still apply! At D2L, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment. We encourage your application even if you don't believe you meet every single qualification outlined, because we love to help our people grow and develop! Why we're awesome: At D2L, we are dedicated to providing you with the tools to do the best work of your life. While some of our perks and benefits may vary depending on location or employment type, we are proud to provide employees with the following through #LifeAtD2L : Impactful work transforming the way the world learns Flexible work arrangements Learning and Growth opportunities Tuition reimbursement of up to $4,000 CAD for continuing education through our SkillsWave Program 2 Paid Days off for SkillsWave-related activities like exams or final assignments Employee wellbeing (Access to mental health services, EFAP program, financial planning and more) Retirement planning 2 Paid Volunteer Days Competitive Benefits Package Home Internet Reimbursements Employee Referral Program Wellness Reimbursement Employee Recognition Social Events Dog Friendly Offices Spaces at our HQ in Kitchener, Winnipeg, Vancouver and Melbourne offices.

title: Poland Country Manager
description: What is the job? Build the Future of Medical Cannabis in Poland This is a genuine founder-style role. You will be Montu's first person on the ground in Poland, with a mandate to build the business from zero : the legal entity, the licences, the supply chain, the clinical model, and eventually the team. You'll own the market-entry strategy while remaining deeply involved in execution. In the early stages, you'll wear multiple hats - meeting with regulators and healthcare providers, negotiating commercial partnerships, solving operational challenges, and ensuring patients can access life-changing treatment. As the business grows, you'll build and lead a high-performing local team, creating the foundations for long-term success. Working closely with our global leadership team, you'll bring together clinical operations, patient experience, regulatory affairs, tech, logistics & supply chain, finance and product to build a scalable, compliant business in a highly regulated healthcare environment. We're looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, loves building from scratch, and is equally comfortable defining strategy as they are making things happen. If you're entrepreneurial, hands-on, commercially astute, and excited by the opportunity to transform access to medical cannabis in Poland, we'd love to hear from you. Please note on contract type: this role will start on a contract basis while we establish the Polish legal entity, with the intention to move to permanent employment once the entity is set up and operational. What will you be doing? Lead the end-to-end launch of Montu in Poland, including establishing a new Polish legal entity and working with the wider European teams for support Own and manage daily operations for Montu Poland, ensuring effective execution across all functional areas as the business is built up Develop and execute market entry and growth strategy to establish and scale the Polish business Build and manage relationships with importers, wholesalers and suppliers of medical cannabis products in Poland Navigate Polish regulatory and licensing requirements for the import, wholesale and distribution of cannabis-based medicines Develop and negotiate the local supply chain, including distribution and logistics partners Scope and, where relevant, help establish clinical partnerships or a clinic model to support patient access Identify, develop and execute new commercial opportunities and strategic partnerships Build and implement operational processes and SOPs across key areas including patient onboarding, logistics, clinical operations, and compliance Recruit, train and develop a high-performing local team as the business grows Collaborate closely with central UK/EU functions (Regulatory, Product, Commercial, Finance, and Partnerships) to ensure alignment and operational excellence Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure operational and commercial success Represent Montu with local regulators, government bodies, industry associations and healthcare stakeholders What do you need? A genuine entrepreneurial mindset - energised by building something from zero, without an existing team or in-market infrastructure to lean on Strong track record of leading small-to-medium teams and building operational structures from scratch Experience owning or working closely with P&L responsibility Experience navigating Polish regulatory and licensing requirements within a regulated sector (pharmaceuticals, medical devices, healthcare, or cannabis) Strong strategic thinking combined with a hands-on, execution-focused mindset Fluent Polish and strong professional English, written and spoken Excellent stakeholder management skills, including with regulators, government bodies and senior internal/external partners Comfortable operating in ambiguity and fast-changing environments, working autonomously while reporting into a remote, international leadership team Willingness to travel across Poland as the business requires Must be fluent in both Polish and English Nice to have: Experience within the Polish cannabis sector - ideally including import, wholesale or distribution of cannabis-based products Established relationships with suppliers, importers and wholesalers in the Polish cannabis or pharmaceutical market Experience setting up or scaling a legal entity or business operation in Poland Experience establishing or operating a clinic or patient-facing healthcare service About Us Montu is a leading international medical cannabis company with operations across Europe and Asia-Pacific, working to make cannabis therapy accessible, reliable and properly integrated into modern healthcare. In the UK, Montu UK runs an end-to-end patient ecosystem covering pharmacy, prescription and care. In Germany, Montu's Alternaleaf platform connects patients with German-licensed doctors for consultation, prescription and pharmacy delivery, entirely online. Poland is the next market in that expansion, and this role leads it.
