title: Sr. Product Marketing Manager, Content Cloud
description: What is Contentstack ? Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system. While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time. Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program. Learn more at www.contentstack.com . Who Are We? At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let’s go! What Are We Looking For? We are seeking an experienced and commercially-minded Sr. Product Marketing Manager to own the commercial strategy for Content Cloud, including our headless CMS, Assets (our DAM), and Launch. This is the largest revenue base in our portfolio and the product line where many of our customers begin their Contentstack journey. This is a senior-level individual contributor role with significant ownership and influence. You’ll own the product line end to end, including positioning, packaging, launches, buyer narratives, pricing, competitive strategy, and field readiness. You’ll also help raise the bar for the broader product marketing team without directly managing them and serve as a strategic resource when the function lead is unavailable. The role has a strong commercial focus. You’ll help protect and grow our largest installed base, drive expansion from CMS into Assets and Launch, and shape how we compete in highly competitive enterprise markets. You’ll also help evolve our story as Contentstack moves toward agentic experiences, using customer insights, market intelligence, and adoption data to continuously improve our strategy. Contentstack is an AI-forward company, and we bring practical experience using AI tools and technologies to improve how we work, learn, solve problems, and drive impact. If you’re excited by the opportunity to own a significant product line, shape how we compete in the market, and make a measurable commercial impact, we’d love to hear from you! Here’s what you’ll be doing: Own the commercial strategy for Content Cloud, including positioning, packaging, launches, buyer narratives, and field readiness. Own the renewal and expansion narrative for our largest installed base, including opportunities to grow adoption of Assets and Launch. Lead competitive strategy, including battlecards, win/loss insights, enterprise RFP/RFI support, and translating competitive deal intelligence into product strategy. Own pricing, packaging, ICP, and core value propositions, partnering closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing. Define and measure adoption goals for launches, using data and customer feedback to improve go-to-market strategies. Bring the voice of the customer and market into our strategy through regular customer conversations, analyst briefings, and competitive research. Represent Contentstack externally through live demos, webinars, customer roundtables, ContentCon, and other market-facing opportunities. Raise the bar for the product marketing team through mentorship, collaboration, and strategic leadership without direct management responsibility. What Really Gets Us Excited About You? 8-12 years of B2B SaaS product marketing experience, including at least 4 years marketing a headless CMS, DXP, DAM, or content infrastructure product. Deep category experience is critical. Hands-on enterprise DAM or content management experience, including familiarity with RFPs and complex enterprise buying processes. Proven experience owning pricing and packaging for a product line and confidently defending your commercial decisions. You can demo a product live and unscripted without relying on a sales engineer. This will be tested during the interview process. Experience positioning against enterprise incumbents and challengers, with a track record of applying lessons from both wins and losses. A demonstrated track record of driving adoption after launch, using data to understand what worked and what needs to change. Strong communication, executive presence, and influence skills, with the ability to work effectively with senior leaders across Product, Sales, Marketing, and the executive team. Additional experience with DAM, retail/commerce, developer audiences, partner ecosystems, product-led growth, or answer engine/search optimization is a plus. You like occasional travel You value a collaborative, fun culture! Salary for this role ranges between $155,000-175,000 based on skill set and experience What Do We Offer? Interesting Work | We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the “challenge yourself” role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you’re doing it. Tribe Vibe | We are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. We have a strict “no a**hole policy” and enforce it diligently. This means we spend time together - with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected. Bragging Rights | We are dreamers and dream makers. Our efforts pay off and we work with the most prestigious brands, from big-name retailers to airlines, to professional sports teams. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more! One Team One Dream | This is one of our values, and it shows. We don’t believe in artificial hierarchies. If you’re part of the tribe, you have an opportunity to contribute. Your voice will be heard and you will also receive regular updates about the business and its performance. Which, btw, is through the roof, so it’s a great time to be joining… To review our Privacy Policy, please click here .

title: Senior Security Detection Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><strong>An overview of this role</strong></p> <p>You will join the growing Detection Engineering team at GitLab - responsible for building and maintaining a best in class detection engineering program. If you love writing threat detections, hunting for patterns of behavioral anomalies across GitLab corporate, cloud and customer environments as well as closing detection gaps you find, this team is for you! We thrive on writing, maintaining and testing our library of threat detections with a focus on automation, LLM aided efficiencies, and behaviors over atomic indicators. </p> <p>We’re looking for an engineer with strong experience building and deploying threat detections using agentic AI capabilities - if you’ve built end to end agentic powered detection pipelines, we want to talk to you! Bonus points if you are experienced in writing SaaS application detections, double bonus points if that application is GitLab! Part of this role will be focused on customer threat detection - turning GitLab threat insights into actionable customer alerts. </p> <p>Find out more about the Detection Engineering team and some of our publications:</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/blog/automated-detection-testing-framework/">Build an automated detection testing framework with GitLab CI/CD and Duo</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/blog/automating-detection-gap-analysis-with-gitlab-duo-agent-platform/">Automating detection gap analysis with GitLab Duo Agent Platform</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/blog/unveiling-the-guard-framework-to-automate-security-detections-at-gitlab/">Unveiling the GUARD framework to automate security detections at GitLab</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/blog/automating-cybersecurity-threat-detections-with-gitlab-ci-cd/">Automating cybersecurity threat detections with GitLab CI/CD</a></li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Identify MITRE ATT&CK/top threat actor detection gaps and write behavioral detections to close them </li> <li>Be a detection SME and deeply understand GitLab’s detection methodology, DaC framework, detection types, and quality thresholds</li> <li>Act as a “detection architect” - orchestrating agents across the entire detection lifecycle and ensuring detection quality and consistency</li> <li>Use a SIEM/data lake platform like Splunk or Elastic to write and troubleshoot threat detections</li> <li>Collaborate with peer GitLab teams to identify and close security observability improvement opportunities</li> <li>Collaborate with incident response, red team, as well as threat intelligence to cross functionally improve GitLab’s detection program and coverage</li> <li>Use, maintain, and build new DaC, AI, and process efficiency automations for the signals engineering program</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>An understanding of the GitLab application, bonus points if you are comfortable detecting and hunting for attacks against GitLab or if you’ve maintained GitLab yourself. </li> <li>SOC, incident response or detection engineering expertise</li> <li>SIEM/security data lake detection and query expertise</li> <li>A proven ability to proactively detecting potentially malicious patterns and collaborating with incident response to complete incident RCAs to identify and implement new detection opportunities</li> <li>Strong Cloud (AWS/GCP)  and some PaaS (Kubernetes/terraform) experience</li> <li>Experience orchestrating teams of agents to write detections - bonus points for experience building full end to end agentic detection pipelines</li> <li>Bring a passion for deep dive threat threat hunting and cross functional purple teaming and turning results into detections</li> <li>Experience with mature detection capabilities such as: Detections as Code, Signal vs detection development, risk based alerting, and behavior analytics. </li> </ul> <p><em>Due to government requirements, you must be a United States Citizen (defined as any individual who is a citizen of the United States by law, birth, or naturalization) to fill this position.</em></p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>Detection Engineering is tasked with detecting suspicious and malicious events for GitLab, our customers and our SaaS operating environments. You'll use Claude Code and GitLab Duo Agent Platform as your default development tools, designing agentic workflows and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with production testing, security, and shared ownership. This is a software engineering role, not ticket-taking internal IT, AI evangelism disconnected from shipped code, or customer-billable Professional Services delivery.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Use Claude Code, GitLab Duo, and other coding agents as your primary development environment for planning, implementation, refactoring, testing, reviews, and documentation. Run multiple agents in parallel on well-scoped tasks, critically review their output, and own every line that reaches production.</li> <li>Build and maintain the team's agent harness, including shared AGENTS.md conventions, skills, slash commands, hooks, subagent definitions, and continuous integration checks. Measure and share what works, publish reusable patterns, and retire those that don't.</li> <li>Ship agents and multi-step workflows for account research, success planning, scoping, status reporting, and customer onboarding. Package them as skills and plugins for non-engineers using Claude, Claude in Slack, and GitLab Duo Agent Platform.</li> <li>Build MCP servers and connectors for governed access to GitLab, Salesforce, Gainsight, Kantata, Thought Industries, Gong, Snowflake, and other enterprise systems. Add evaluations, tracing, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints to keep internal and customer-facing agents measurable, auditable, and safe with customer data.</li> <li>Evolve the CX Application Platform's gateway, Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure, including Elastic Container Service (ECS), Relational Database Service (RDS), and Lambda, Terraform configuration, application scaffold, and deployment path. Own applications such as PS Compass, Congregate, and GitLab University and its integrations, documenting build-versus-buy and consolidate-or-sunset decisions.</li> <li>Ship production-quality Python and TypeScript through GitLab continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), with tests, observability, security review, and runbooks. Design every application for handoff, with documentation, monitoring, and shared ownership.</li> <li>Prototype with Customer Success, Digital Success, Professional Services, Education Services, and Training in days, not quarters. Help CX team members bring their own applications to production, and turn field learning into reusable reference implementations, development paths, and enablement.</li> <li>Contribute upstream to GitLab and share product feedback with Product and Engineering. Mentor engineers and non-engineers on agentic development and raise the team's code review bar.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience building and operating production software, owning multi-quarter work from ambiguity to production, choosing reusable platform solutions over one-off customization where appropriate, and designing for handoff.</li> <li>Daily, hands-on use of coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitLab Duo, or similar on production work. You can show how they've changed what you ship and how you maintain quality.</li> <li>Experience building with large language models (LLMs) beyond chat, including tool use, MCP servers, agent loops, context and retrieval design, prompt and workflow design, and evaluations.</li> <li>Strong Python skills with FastAPI or Flask and TypeScript skills with Vue or React, including application programming interface (API) design, authentication, authorization, and secure handling of customer and business data.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with AWS ECS, RDS, and Lambda, Terraform, Docker, and applications running behind single sign-on (SSO), such as Okta.</li> <li>Experience integrating enterprise systems through Representational State Transfer (REST) and GraphQL APIs, and fluency with Git, merge requests, and CI/CD.</li> <li>Experience translating non-engineering stakeholders' workflows into technical plans and writing clear asynchronous design documents, decision records, and enablement materials. You align with GitLab's values and are willing to use GitLab for your own work.</li> <li>Optional experience includes agent harness customization; the GitLab Development Kit, Duo Agent Platform custom agents and flows, or AI Catalog publishing; enterprise agent governance and data controls; customer success, professional services, or learning platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, Kantata, or Thought Industries; professional services economics and customer success metrics; Snowflake or similar warehouses; and technical writing, talks, or open source contributions on agentic development.</li> </ul> <p>We welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; you don't need to meet every nice-to-have to apply.</p> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>CX Platform Engineering builds and runs CX Applications for Customer Success, Digital Success, Professional Services, Education Services, and Training. We own the CX Application Platform's gateway and infrastructure alongside our application portfolio: GitLab University, the Foundational Onboarding Agent in GitLab Duo Agent Platform, Congregate, PS Compass, and Customer Wins. We build the first version with the people doing the work, turn what we learn into a reusable pattern, then hand it off so it runs without us. We reward leverage, not heroics, and don't leave tools dependent on one person.</p> <h4><br><br></h4><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Project Manager
description: We are seeking an energetic, adaptable Project Manager to lead end-to-end client implementations and rollouts. In a fast-growing scale-up, project management isn't just about updating spreadsheets—it's about driving delivery pace, mitigating real-world risks, aligning cross-functional teams, and making sure our technology delivers immediate, tangible value in live operational environments. At Tended, we create first-of-a-kind safety systems that use some of the most advanced technologies on the market to transform rail worker safety. Our flagship geofencing solution has been named as one of TIME’s Best Inventions and has made it onto the Digital Leaders 100 list for Geospatial Initiative of the Year. We’re a venture-backed scale-up with an incredible team and work alongside industry-leading organisations in the rail sector to innovate and bring rail workers home safe every day. Tended is growing quickly and we're now recruiting for Project Managers to support our technology deployments on client sites around the UK. Tasks Key Responsibilities Project Planning & Governance: Build and maintain detailed project plans, critical path timelines, and resource schedules using project management software (e.g., MS Project, Jira). Risk & Scope Management: Continuously track risks, manage dependencies, resolve delivery blockers, and maintain scope control across parallel client deployments. On-the-Ground Rollouts: Take charge of live implementations. You're comfortable being on-site in operational settings (such as depots, hubs, or shift-based operations) to support deployments—including occasional weekend, bank holiday, or overnight shifts when rollouts go live. Training & User Adoption: Develop and deliver training programs tailored to different end-user cohorts—from tech-savvy site leaders to frontline operational workers—ensuring capability and long-term retention. Proactive Problem Solving: Take total ownership of project issues. When deployment roadblocks appear, you take the initiative to find creative, pragmatic solutions to keep projects moving forward. Client Reporting & Value Insights: Measure deployment progress and operational outcomes. Write clear, structured reports that demonstrate project performance, ROI, and key insights to client stakeholders Requirements About You Proven PM Experience: Track record managing complex technical projects, deployments, or system rollouts end-to-end. Start-Up / Scale-Up Agility: High ownership, proactive, and comfortable creating structure in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities. Strong Leadership & Communication: Exceptional stakeholder management skills -able to speak the language of engineers, enterprise leads, and frontline operations. Full UK Driving Licence: Essential for visiting client operational sites across regions. Desirable Qualifications & Experience Domain Expertise: Prior project experience in the rail, transport, logistics, or infrastructure sectors is a major advantage. Academic Background: Degree or professional qualifications in Project Management (e.g., PRINCE2, PMP, APM), Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. Commercial Acumen: Understanding of how project outcomes tie into client retention, expansion, and long-term account value. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Director, Global SME Solutions Architecture
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h3><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h3> <p>As the Senior Director, Global Subject Matter Expertise (SME) Solutions Architecture, you will build and lead GitLab's Subject Matter Expert organization: three regional teams in AMER, EMEA and APJ, each covering Security & Compliance, Platform, Core DevSecOps, and AI & Competitive. Together you will make sure GitLab brings the right depth to the right opportunities, and that what the field learns shapes what GitLab builds next.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Set the strategy, operating model and global standards for the SME organization, aligned to the VP Global SA and GitLab's go-to-market plan.</li> <li>Build the resourcing model from product-level bookings and consumption targets. paths.</li> <li>Create and improve upon the processes, metrics and KPIs for SME-led technical evaluations, workshops, demos and Proofs of Value.</li> <li>Partner with CRO staff, regional sales leaders and AVPs on product-category performance, forecast risk and competitive strategy.</li> <li>Partner with Enablement to drive  field readiness for new product launches with Product Marketing and Enablement, including Duo Agent Platform, security and platform offerings.</li> <li>Build strong relationships with key customers at the technical sponsor and executive level.</li> <li>Use AI to change how the team works, including deal research, demo creation, PoV automation and knowledge sharing.</li> <li>Drive organizational transformation by finding gaps early, building structure where none exists, and leading change without waiting for top-down direction.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years second-line leadership experience (managing managers) in Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering or a technical specialist organization.</li> <li>Experience building or scaling a specialist, overlay or global SA team in enterprise SaaS, DevSecOps, security or developer tools.</li> <li>A record of tying technical-team design to bookings and consumption outcomes, with the data to show it.</li> <li>The ability to lead through ambiguity and rapid organizational change, bringing clarity and direction while strategy is still forming.</li> <li>Strong relationships with Product and Engineering leaders, and a history of shaping roadmap from field insight.</li> <li>Fluency across the software development lifecycle, application security (SAST, DAST, SCA), cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), Kubernetes and AI-assisted development, including LLM evaluation and production deployment patterns.</li> <li>Executive presence with technical practitioners, managers and C-level stakeholders.</li> <li>Proven ability to partner across Sales, Partners, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success and Professional Services.</li> <li>A self-starting, entrepreneurial approach. You don't wait for a playbook; you write it.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>How you'll be measured</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Global product-category commit attainment and consumption growth.</li> <li>Time from technical win to first workload in customer’s production environment on SME-engaged opportunities compared with non-engaged opportunities.</li> <li>SME coverage and engagement speed on the top 10% of opportunities.</li> <li>Account Team capability lift: fewer escalations and more deals handled without an SME over time.</li> <li>Product impact: field sentiment on the product feedback process along with field-sourced requirements adopted into the roadmap.</li> <li>Team health: hiring against plan, manager development, engagement and retention.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>The Subject Matter Expertise (SME) organization is part of GitLab's Solutions Architecture team, a trusted technical partner for the field. SMEs bring the deepest product expertise to GitLab's most complex opportunities and carry customer feedback into conversations about product direction, enablement and value messaging. The team is distributed and all-remote, and relies on clear communication, strong judgment and shared operating practices across regions.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Senior Service Analyst, Workforce Management
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍Remote UK | 💰£40,400 - £51,050 (12 Month Fixed Term Contract)  +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers"> Benefits</a> ✨<br><br>⭐ <strong>Our Workforce Management (WFM) team</strong></p> <p>This is an excellent opportunity to step into a key Senior Service Analyst role on a 12-month fixed-term contract. You'll report to the WFM Service Manager and play a vital role in using data-driven insights to perfectly staff our customer operations and service teams.</p> <p>You will be a strong individual contributor, taking ownership of problems and leading on the design and implementation of solutions from start to finish. We are looking for someone with strong data skills to perform in-depth analysis, automate processes, and create independent Management Information (MI) and dashboards to support operations. You will help us comfortably navigate challenging trade-offs to achieve our goals while giving our customers the best experience possible.<br><br></p> <p>🔑 <strong>You'll play a key role in:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Executive Communication & Reporting:</strong> You will compile data-driven reports that provide key insights and actions for senior stakeholders, including weekly reporting, Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs), Ops Monitoring, and Domain Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs).</li> <li><strong>Data Pipeline & Dashboard Creation:</strong> Independently creating fully functional Looker dashboards and developing standalone MI to support the operations teams.</li> <li><strong>In-depth Analysis & Automation:</strong> Performing confident root-cause analysis by filtering, merging, and amending complex data across Looker, Anaplan, Airtable, and Google Sheets. You will write efficient SQL code and facilitate automation wherever possible to improve efficiency.</li> <li><strong>Dynamic Burndown Plans:</strong> Creating dynamic burndown plans to accurately predict return-to-service dates and forecast when service situations will be fully resolved.</li> <li><strong>Incident Management & Rota:</strong> Taking responsibility for managing cross-domain incidents using data-driven and dynamic solutions. You will be on call for incidents as part of a Monday to Friday rota. You may occasionally be asked to work a weekend to support very specific projects, but this is not part of your standard working pattern.</li> <li><strong>Service Deep Dives & Routing:</strong> Conducting deep dives to identify gaps between supply and demand, managing task views and routing, and ensuring the right work goes to the right person at the right time.</li> <li><strong>Global Ops Alignment:</strong> Working closely with our global ops functions to ensure performance expectations are met and assessing the service impact of proposed changes across various domains.<br><br></li> </ul> <p>🤩 <strong>We'd love to hear from you if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have demonstrable experience in service delivery, optimisation, and workforce management within a fast-paced, high-growth environment.</li> <li>You are highly capable of managing a project's entire lifecycle with little oversight, taking accountability for driving solutions and leading implementation.</li> <li>You possess an advanced ability to use Looker and Google Sheets for deep data storytelling and presenting clear findings via Google Slides and Documents.</li> <li>You have experience handling incidents, creating actionable plans, and thinking of dynamic, data-driven solutions.</li> <li>You are comfortable with critical conversations, communicating effectively to a wide range of stakeholders, and coaching those around you to elevate team performance.</li> <li>You have a great understanding of task views, task types, routing, scheduled activities, and workforce optimisation principles.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p>🙌 <strong>What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰£40,400 - £51,050 (12-Month Fixed Term Contract).<br>📍This role can be based remotely anywhere in the UK, or our London or Cardiff office.<br>⏰ You will be on call for incidents as part of a Monday to Friday rota. You may occasionally be asked to work a weekend to support very specific projects, but this is not part of your standard working pattern.<br>🏡We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given MacBooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.<br>📚£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.<br>➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of<a href="https://monzo.com/careers"> benefits.</a></p> <p><br>🌈 <strong>The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Application Questions</li> <li>Call with a Recruiter</li> <li>Take Home Task</li> <li>Final Stage Interview: Task Presentation + Technical & Values questions</li> </ul> <p>🤖 We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> here</a>.</p> <p><strong>We'll only close this advert once we have enough applications. Apply as soon as possible to not miss out!</strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong><strong>#LI-REMOTE #LI-MY</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Engineering Manager
description: <h2 style="text-align: center;"><span style="color: #7e8c8d;">Engineering Manager </span></h2> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="color: rgb(126, 140, 141);">Engineering</span></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(126, 140, 141);"><em> </em></span></p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="color: rgb(126, 140, 141);"><em> Prolific</em></span></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.</span></p> <p style="text-align: center;"> </p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="color: rgb(126, 140, 141);"><em>The role</em></span></p> <p style="text-align: center;">At Prolific, our product development group is a powerhouse of Engineering, Product, Data, Design, and Research – all working in lockstep. You'll thrive in cross-functional teams, each with a clear mission and the freedom to self-organize and innovate towards the best possible outcomes. We're passionate about moving fast and continuously improving, and we champion strong engineering principles and a culture of strong ownership.</p> <p style="text-align: center;">As an Engineering Manager, you won't just manage; you'll inspire, empower, and elevate. You'll cultivate high-performing engineers and champion good engineering practices. Working hand-in-hand with your Product Manager, you'll ensure your team is not just set up for success, but poised to deliver exceptional customer impact.</p> <p style="text-align: center;">This is a hands-on technical leadership role where your expertise will directly impact the technical excellence of your teams' work. You'll be instrumental in driving technical decision-making and collaboratively building scalable, resilient, and maintainable systems that power the future of AI.</p> <p style="text-align: center;"> </p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="color: rgb(126, 140, 141);"><em>What you’ll bring to the role</em></span></p> <ul> <li>Experience in engineering management or equivalent coaching, mentoring and leadership experience as an individual contributor </li> <li>A demonstrable track record of building products and leading complex initiatives and designing systems  </li> <li>Exceptional problem-solving and deep understanding of software engineering</li> <li>Clear and structured communication skills, with an ability to lead diverse teams, influence stakeholders, and collaborate effectively across all levels and disciplines.</li> <li>5+ years of professional software development experience, including hands-on expertise building highly available, transactional, and distributed cloud-based applications</li> <li>Strong web frontend expertise with proven experience building secure and customer facing frontend applications and strong knowledge of modern web technologies</li> </ul> <p style="text-align: center;"> </p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="color: rgb(126, 140, 141);"><em>What you’ll be doing in the role </em></span></p> <ul> <li>Lead, coach engineering teams to consistently deliver outstanding customer value.</li> <li>Nurture the professional growth of your engineers, including impactful hiring, onboarding and performance management.</li> <li>Create a healthy  and predictable pace of work by proactively planning, removing blockers, orchestrating dependencies, and fostering crystal-clear communication within and beyond your team.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with product managers and your team to define both <em>what</em> to build and <em>how</em> to build it</li> <li>With your team, drive the technical solution design and implementation, ensuring alignment with the overarching technical direction</li> <li>Collaborate closely with product managers and the team to manage technical debt and toil and provide support for existing systems</li> <li>Contribute to defining and evolving Prolific's engineering practices and cross team initiatives</li> </ul> <p style="text-align: center;"> </p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="color: rgb(126, 140, 141);"><em>Key Technologies </em></span></p> <ul> <li> <ul> <li><strong>Cloud Platforms:</strong> Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS)</li> <li><strong>Programming Languages:</strong> Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Vue.js </li> <li><strong>Frameworks:</strong> Django Rest Framework, Serverless architectures, title: Chief Financial Officer (all genders)
description: Your mission deskbird is one of Europe's fastest-growing workplace-management platforms – a SaaS success story serving hundreds of enterprise customers and building the operating system for the workplace of the future, well past €10M ARR and scaling with an efficiency-driven playbook. In 2025 we closed a funding round led by Octopus Ventures, with co-investments from NEVA SGR (Intesa Sanpaolo Bank) and AVP, and participation from Alstin Capital, session, and Portfolion. We're hiring a Chief Financial Officer (all genders) to be a true co-pilot to the management team. This is not just a back-office finance role. You will sit in board meetings from day one, own the equity story, lead our future financing rounds and capital markets strategy, and run an AI-first operations function that becomes a case study in how lean a modern finance organization can be. You'll join a small, talented, highly ambitious executive team – and the equity package is designed so that when we win, you win meaningfully. If you are passionate about creating enterprise value, scaling finance organizations, and owning the story you used to analyze – this is that seat. In this role you will The equity story and funding readiness. You will keep deskbird in the best possible shape for whatever comes next - future financing rounds, strategic options, and long-term value creation. Narrative, metrics, data room, diligence readiness: always current, always credible. When we choose to run a process, you will lead it, working directly with the founders and board. The path to profitability. You’ll own the plan that takes us to sustainable positive cash flows profitability without sacrificing growth: driver-based planning, disciplined capital allocation, and a sharp view on where every franc and euro works hardest. An AI-first finance & operations function. We want a hands-on operator on the edge of AI development who automates before hiring, works in the models and tools personally, and proves that a lean, AI-augmented team can outperform a traditional org several times its size. We don’t want a CFO who builds a 20-person department. Commercial intelligence for GTM and Product. You’ll drive the insights that tell us where to invest: which segments, motions, and product bets deliver the strongest combined growth and efficiency profile. Finance at deskbird is a value driver in pricing, packaging, NRR economics, and unit-economics decisions - not just a scorekeeper. International structure and tax efficiency. You’ll own our multi-entity group structure across Europe, introduce transfer pricing, and ensure we operate in a tax-efficient, fully compliant setup as we scale internationally. The cap table and investor-grade financials. You’ll keep our cap table and VSOP clean, well-modeled, and always ready for the next financing round, and bring our accounting to the standard any institutional investor expects - SaaS revenue recognition (local GAAP) done right, smooth statutory audits, and, where a future process demands it, conversion to the relevant GAAP. Board and investor relations. You’ll run the reporting rhythm, build trust with our existing investors, and represent deskbird credibly to future ones - from day one, alongside the founders. Cash, risk, and the operational backbone. Treasury, FX, and runway discipline, scenario planning, audit readiness, and oversight of legal, procurement, and insurance. What you need to be successful Must-haves A transaction-shaped career: ideally PE, M&A or investment banking, followed by operating experience in a scaling company - you’ve seen deals from the inside and know what investors actually sign up for. (Exceptional candidates from transaction advisory (e.g. Big4) or top-tier strategy consulting with strong deal exposure will also be considered.) Deep fluency in finance processes and B2B SaaS mechanics: ARR/NRR, cohort economics, CAC payback, Rule of 40, the ARR-to-cash bridge. Experience at our scale and complexity (>€10M ARR, ~100+ employees) - and ideally, you’ve already seen what comes next (>€25M ARR), so you know what to build now and what to deliberately skip. Fundraising and/or liquidity event exposure , ideally where the story was efficient, profitable growth rather than growth at all costs. A builder’s ego profile: you measure yourself by enterprise value created per person on your team, not by headcount or budget owned. You’re hands-on and want to stay that way. Genuine excitement about AI-native ways of working - you’re already using these tools daily and want to push further. Based in or willing to work from one of our hubs - Zurich, Berlin, Munich, or London (remote within Europe is possible for an outstanding candidate, but hub-based is our strong preference given the closeness to founders and board). Full working proficiency in English; German is strongly preferred. Nice to have Experience owning or partnering closely with People & Culture. Multi-entity European operations: Swiss/EU accounting, VAT, transfer pricing, cross-border payroll. Venture debt, structured financing, or buy-side M&A experience. What’s in it for you? A rare stage - big enough to matter (>€10M ARR, enterprise customers, proven playbook), small enough that your fingerprints will be on everything. Meaningful equity upside - a package built for a founder-like profile in a capital-efficient business, where the value you help create is value you share in. A real seat at the table - board meetings from day one, direct partnership with the founders, and full ownership of your domain. An AI-first culture - the freedom (and expectation) to build the most modern finance function in European SaaS. A high-talent, low-ego executive team that moves fast and debates openly. title: Senior Product Designer (m/f/d)
description: At Klim, we work with farmers and businesses to make regenerative agriculture a scalable and economically viable part of the food system. As a German AgriTech company, we empower farmers in improving soil health, increasing biodiversity, and capturing carbon, while generating reliable income through our platform. Backed by €22 million in Series A funding, we are scaling our impact internationally and partnering with clients from the food and non-food industry. Since 2020, we have worked with more than 4,000 farmers across 900,000 hectares, covering more than 5% of Germany’s agricultural land. If you are motivated by building a more sustainable food system and contributing to measurable climate impact, Klim offers the opportunity to do so at scale. Your mission: Own the design experience of Klim end to end, and build the AI-augmented design process that lets a small design team and product managers ship coherent, high-quality work at scale. You'll do the hardest design work yourself and raise the level of everyone who designs around you. This means it is a player/coach role with 60% hands-on design and 40% building the system and process around you. What you'll do Product experience: Own the end-to-end experience across farmer and partner journeys, from onboarding through assessment, planning and improvement, verification and reporting and paymnet, shaping journeys and value moments with product managers, not only interfaces. Design the most complex and brand-critical work, from wireframes and flows to polished, high-fidelity interaction and visual design. Cut farmer effort, with a focus on "enter once, used everywhere" data capture, simpler onboarding and self-serve help. Run continuous research, usability testing and A/B tests with farmers and partners, and track experience metrics (activation, task completion, time-to-value, satisfaction) with product and analytics. AI-augmented design process: Own and deliver Klim's AI-augmented design model maintaining highest quality while enabling others to deliver simpler design needs under your guidance Own the canonical design system with engineering: components and page templates, with code as the source of truth and Figma kept in sync. Define the handoff contract and the automated and human coherence checks, using AI tooling (e.g. Claude Code, Claude Design, Figma, Storybook) and rules AI tools can follow. Measure and improve the process: self-serve share, first-pass coherence, review time, engineering rework and ticket-to-design lead time. Engineering efficiency and quality: Partner with engineering leads to simplify and standardise how UI is built, so new features reuse proven patterns instead of starting from scratch. Reduce design-related rework by making requirements, states and edge cases explicit before build. Govern the intake of new patterns and log any exceptions, so the system grows deliberately rather than drifting. Coach: Enable product managers to design simpler elements well within the system through templates, patterns, content rules and review. Build design rituals (critique, design reviews, a shared quality bar) and make the case for design decisions with evidence across product, engineering and commercial teams. What you bring: 5+ years in product design, including senior or lead roles owning complex B2B or data-heavy products end to end. Exceptional interaction and visual design craft, with mastery of Figma. You'll personally deliver the most complex and brand-critical work. A portfolio that shows product-level impact (engagement, adoption, satisfaction), not only interface quality. Proven ability to improve engagement and strong plus for experience running A/B tests and product experiments and strong research skills. Proven experience building and running a design system with engineering, ideally in React and Storybook, with tokens and components treated as code. Hands-on use of AI tools in design and delivery (e.g. Claude, Figma AI or similar), and a clear view of where they help and where they don't. A track record of designing processes others adopt, coaching designers and enabling non-designers, while still doing strong hands-on work. Clear communication with farmers, engineers and executives alike. Fluent English. Nice to have: German, to speak directly with farmers. Experience in agriculture, climate, sustainability or other multi-sided platforms. Experience with multi-language products and content design. Why join Klim Opportunity: Be part of our journey from the very beginning, working on an equal footing with the leadership team to build a new company. Impact: Your work helps farmers move to regenerative practice and helps companies cut supply-chain emissions. Ownership: you'll set how design works at Klim, with direct access to leadership and a clear influence on the product roadmap. Competitive package: competitive salary and participation in our VSIP program. Flexible work: At Klim, we foster a flexible, hybrid work approach and facilitate remote work (within the EU). It is advantageous for this role if you live in Berlin or can be present in our office regularly. Additional benefits : We offer a subsidy for a membership in Urban Sports Club or the Deutschlandticket (if based in Germany), a company pension scheme, plus team lunches and regular team events. At Klim, we believe that a thriving workplace is built on the diverse backgrounds, talents, and perspectives of our team. We grow stronger together by embracing and building on each individual’s unique strengths. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. All hiring and personnel decisions are made solely based on qualifications, performance, and the needs of the company - ensuring fairness and equal opportunity for all. title: Health claims lead (f/m/x)
description: Intro As our Health Claims lead, you'll own claims decisions on Feather's health MGA books from day one: coverage, declines, settlement amounts, all within policy terms. You'll manage our insurance carrier relationships, decide how we work with service providers, and build the playbook, automations and systems that let the function scale as we grow MGA health claims fast across expat and international health. At Feather, we're building insurance that actually matters to our customers. It rests on three principles: a fully digital experience, modern and flexible plans, and reliable human support. And because we build it all for expats living abroad, we're a genuinely different kind of insurer. Why work at Feather? We're small, lean, and we love what we do. The usual buzzwords here, except we actually mean them. Staying small helps us focus on what matters, and we want to keep it that way. You'll work on a product that is loved by customers. Our excellent Trustpilot and Google reviews speak for themselves. There's plenty of space to grow. We trust you to take ownership and make real decisions from day one, and you'll have all the support you need to succeed. You'll have the freedom to build something from scratch. You're not inheriting a finished system. You're building the decision logic, reporting, and playbook that let health claims scale. Flexible remote work policy. We offer a remote-first work environment, hiring across Europe via an Employer of Record . We host company retreats, team dinners, and meetups to spend in-person time together. What you bring to the table You have hands-on experience handling health claims across borders or internationally. You are familiar with medical coding and provider billing. You have an instinct for automation and AI tooling, and you use it daily. You take tough decisions daily, including saying no to customers, and you still enjoy the work. You are pragmatic in an unfinished system: you improve it while running it. You are a fluent English speaker. Nice to have: German, Spanish, or French language skills. Experience with moratorium underwriting. A medical background. Experience in an MGA or delegated authority setup. Experience managing third-party administrators (TPAs). You'll be responsible for You will make claims decisions You will interpret coverage, decide declines, settlement amounts, and goodwill within policy terms, with real authority, not recommend-and-wait. You will handle expat and international health claims: cross-border invoices across languages and billing conventions, currency and tax, and coordination with statutory and private cover in the country of residence. You will manage our carrier relationships You will own claims reporting and bordereaux, contentious cases, and coverage disputes with our insurance partners. You will keep audit-ready records throughout, so nothing surprises the carrier. You will decide how we work with service providers You will decide where using third-party administrators (TPAs) makes sense, and manage instructions, quality, turnaround, and commercial performance where we use them. You will build the operating model You will close gaps with product and engineering across intake, documents, decision support, payout, and automation. You will run audits and fraud checks, working toward semi-automated monitoring with the data team. You will build capability You will write the playbook so health claims stops depending on one person. You will train whoever joins the team next. What will the interview process look like? CV screening Initial phone call with our People team. We'll have a chat and get to know each other (30m) Hiring manager call. We'll cover the role, skills needed, and answer your questions (1 hour) Case study. We'll give you a case study to work on, which will give you an idea of the type of projects you'd take on at Feather (3-4h) Case study discussion. We'll go through your reasoning and approach together (90min) Call with our Head of Ops. We'll talk through our async, remote-first way of working and how our team operates day to day (45min) Final interview. You'll be speaking to one member of our leadership team (45min) Does this sound like a good fit for you? Apply now! At Feather, we actively foster inclusive representation within our teams and embrace a diverse mix of talent. We encourage applicants from all educational paths to apply: we believe that what you’ve built, worked on, and achieved is far more important than on-paper qualifications. title: Senior Account Executive
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>Aa Senior Account Executive, you’ll be the primary connection between GitLab and our Commercial & Enterprise customers, working with organizations of up to 4,000 team members to help them adopt and expand the world’s most comprehensive AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You’ll own a broad book of business across a wide range of opportunity sizes, guiding small, fast-growing teams as well as more complex projects as they modernize their software delivery with GitLab. Reporting to an Area Sales Manager and partnering closely with business development, marketing, and technical teams, you’ll run the full sales process: shaping the customer’s journey, documenting buying criteria and processes, ensuring accurate pipeline based on evidence, and sharing root-cause insights on wins and losses. In your first year, you’ll focus on building trusted relationships, delivering meaningful business outcomes for customers, and being the voice of the customer internally by contributing ideas to our public issue tracker and improving our sales handbook.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Report to an Regional Sales Director and own a broad book of Commercial & Enterprise business, from new prospects to growing existing accounts.</li> <li value="2">Manage the full sales cycle for Commercial & Enterprise prospects, from discovery and solution alignment through negotiation and close.</li> <li value="3">Support GitLab for Commercial & Enterprise prospects by clearly articulating our DevSecOps value proposition and aligning it to customer business outcomes.</li> <li value="4">Analyze wins and losses, contribute to root cause analyses, and share lessons learned with account managers, marketing, and technical teams.</li> <li value="5">Document and maintain accurate buying criteria, buying processes, next steps, and owners to ensure a reliable, evidence-based pipeline.</li> <li value="6">Contribute to improving our sales handbook and processes by documenting best practices and opportunities for refinement.</li> <li value="7">Provide account leadership and direction across pre- and post-sales, partnering closely with technical teams and customer success.</li> <li value="8">Represent the voice of the customer by contributing product feedback and ideas to our public issue tracker.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Proven success in software sales, ideally in a Enterprise market context, managing a varied book of business.</li> <li value="2">Ability to guide customers through the full buying journey, including defining buying criteria, mapping buying processes, and driving clear next steps.</li> <li value="3">Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with business development, marketing, technical teams, and sales management.</li> <li value="4">Experience documenting and maintaining accurate pipeline data and account plans based on evidence rather than assumptions.</li> <li value="5">Skill in conducting and contributing to win/loss and root cause analyses, and sharing insights to improve team performance and processes.</li> <li value="6">Proficiency in negotiation, presenting to customer stakeholders, and leading commercial discussions to close opportunities.</li> <li value="7">Interest in GitLab, open source software, and preferably familiarity with Git, software development tools, or application lifecycle management.</li> <li value="8">Alignment with GitLab’s values and an interest in contributing from diverse or transferable sales backgrounds, with willingness to travel in line with company policy.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Commercial & Enterprise Sales team focuses on helping growing organizations adopt and expand GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform across their software delivery lifecycle. You’ll join a distributed group of Account Executives, sales managers, and business development team members who collaborate asynchronously across regions to manage a broad book of business in the mid-market segment. We partner closely with marketing, sales development, and technical teams to run an efficient, transparent sales process, document what works in our sales handbook, and represent the voice of the customer back into GitLab. We focus on opportunities like supporting customers through toolchain consolidation, driving platform adoption, and sharing learnings from wins and losses to continuously improve how we sell and support GitLab.</p> <p><span style="color: rgb(236, 240, 241);">#LI-CW1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. And you’ll be the connective tissue that keeps us operating effectively: tracking performance, surfacing insights, and making sure we’re focused on what really matters.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a title: Pflichtpraktikum als Marketing-Manager im B2B (m/w/d)
description: CENDAS wurde 2021 mit der Vision gegründet, Bauprojekte von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung zu digitalisieren. Unsere Software verbindet echtes Handwerk mit digitalen Prozessen: Vorbereitung, Abwicklung, Steuerung – alle Phasen des Bauprojekts in einer Anwendung. Heute setzen wir als schnell wachsendes Scale-Up mit unserem internationalen Team aus rund 65 Expert:innen neue Maßstäbe für Effizienz und Innovation in der Bauindustrie. Bei uns kannst du echten Start-up-Spirit erleben und gleichzeitig von strukturierten Prozessen profitieren. Unser Vertriebsteam bietet dir die Möglichkeit, aktiv an unseren Vertriebs- und Marketingprozessen mitzuwirken. Wenn du in einem flexiblen, innovativen und schnell wachsenden Unternehmen echte Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Aufgaben Im Rahmen deines Pflichtpraktikums steigst du ins Marketing eines wachsenden B2B-SaaS-Unternehmens ein und lernst, wie Kampagnen, Events und Kundenkommunikation geplant, umgesetzt und datenbasiert gesteuert werden. Konkret übernimmst du folgende Aufgaben: HandwerkNext-Veranstaltungen: Du unterstützt bei Planung, Bewerbung und Nachbereitung unserer HandwerkNext-Events, von der Einladungskampagne über die Teilnehmerkommunikation bis zur Auswertung. Zwei Reisen zu den Veranstaltungen sind fest eingeplant, und du bist vor Ort dabei. E-Mail- und Kampagnenmarketing: Du erstellst Newsletter, Mailings und In-App-Nachrichten, schreibst Texte, die unsere Zielgruppe im Handwerk ansprechen, und setzt A/B-Tests auf. Kampagnenauswertung: Du behältst Öffnungs-, Klick- und Anmeldezahlen im Blick, wertest Kampagnen aus und leitest daraus konkrete Verbesserungen ab. Marketing im CRM: Du pflegst Kontakte, Listen und Segmente in HubSpot, damit die richtige Botschaft bei den richtigen Leuten ankommt. Marketing-Automatisierung: Du baust und testest automatisierte E-Mail-Strecken und Nurturing-Abläufe, ganz ohne Programmierung und direkt in HubSpot. Eigenes Projekt: In der zweiten Hälfte deines Praktikums übernimmst du ein abgrenzbares Marketingthema mit sichtbarem Ergebnis, zum Beispiel eine Event-Kampagne für HandwerkNext oder eine Onboarding-Mailstrecke für Neukunden. Qualifikation Dein Profil: Du stehst kurz vor dem Studienabschluss – idealerweise in BWL, Marketing, Vertrieb oder Kommunikations- & Medienwissenschaften. Du brauchst ein Pflichtpraktikum – und willst in der Zeit wirklich etwas bewegen, nicht nur Meetings protokollieren. Strukturiert und systematisch zu arbeiten ist für dich kein Zwang, sondern dein natürlicher Modus. Deutsch beherrschst du sicher in Wort und Schrift. Du wartest nicht auf Aufgaben, sondern packst Dinge eigenständig an. Du willst nicht nur zuschauen, sondern aktiv an unseren Marketingkampagnen und Events mitwirken – in einem Team, das Tempo mag. Praktikumsdauer: Die Dauer des Praktikums richtet sich nach den Vorgaben deiner Universität. Benefits Unser Angebot: Remote-First: Arbeite, von wo du willst – zuhause, unterwegs oder in unserem Coworking Space in Bochum. Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Feste Kernzeiten fürs Team, den Rest gestaltest du so, wie es zu deinem Leben passt. Start-up-Feeling: Du bist von Tag eins an mittendrin statt nur dabei – deine Meinung zählt wirklich. Strukturiertes Onboarding: Kein Sprung ins kalte Wasser – wir bringen dir das nötige Know-how gezielt bei, damit du schnell loslegst. Enge Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Marketing Manager und bekommst Einblicke, die du im Studium so nicht bekommst. Bewerbung Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf, deinen frühestmöglichen Starttermin und die geplante Dauer deines Praktikums – am einfachsten über das Formular. Ein Motivationsschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schreib uns stattdessen zwei, drei Sätze: Was interessiert dich am Marketing, und welches Tool hast du dir schon mal selbst beigebracht? Weil es sich um ein Pflichtpraktikum handelt, brauchen wir außerdem den Auszug aus deiner Studien- oder Prüfungsordnung, in dem das Praktikum und seine Dauer vorgeschrieben sind. Den kannst du nachreichen. Du hörst innerhalb von fünf Werktagen von uns. Fragen vorher? Melde dich direkt bei Robert, Marketing Manager bei CENDAS. CENDAS GmbH Südring 25 | 44787 Bochum +49 171 9116576 Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join our Infrastructure Data Science team. In this role, you’ll partner with engineering and cross-functional teams to make Pinterest’s infrastructure more measurable, intelligible, and actionable. Depending on the area, your work may span app performance, shopping infrastructure, metrics quality, infrastructure governance, or site reliability. You’ll help build the data foundations, measurement systems, and analytical frameworks that enable Pinterest to optimize core technical systems and make better product and infrastructure decisions. Strengthen data foundations by improving metric definitions, auditing data quality, and contributing to pipeline and measurement improvements where needed. Design and analyze experiments, investigations, and deep dives to quantify the impact of infrastructure changes on user experience, reliability, and business outcomes. Translate ambiguous technical problems into clear analyses and actionable recommendations for engineering and platform partners. Support high-priority investigations and decision-making related to infrastructure performance, reliability, cost, and measurement quality. Identify opportunities to improve how Pinterest measures and optimizes infrastructure across a range of domains, such as performance, shopping infrastructure, governance, metrics quality, and site reliability. What we’re looking for: Masters degree in a relevant field such as Statistics, Applied Math, Biostatistics, or equivalent experience. Experience partnering on or contributing to production-ready data pipelines, measurement systems, or foundational data work that improves data quality and usability. Solid foundation in experimentation and measurement, with the ability to design analyses, interpret results rigorously, and partner effectively with engineers and other cross-functional stakeholders. title: Senior Corporate Strategist
description: At Serve Robotics , we’re reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. It’s designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses. The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. We’re looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity. Who We Are We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully. JOB OVERVIEW The Senior Corporate Strategist is the analytical engine behind Serve's enterprise partnerships and many of our core internal strategic decisions. The role produces the research, models, and materials that make a decision or partnership case credible to a counterparty's deal team, and independently owns discrete workstreams on questions such as market entry and city sequencing, build-versus-buy-versus-partner, competitive positioning, etc. The role independently frames open-ended questions, builds rigorous analyses, and turns findings into the meeting briefs, decks/models and recommendations that help leadership make decisions and win consequential deals. The position creates value by turning messy inputs - public filings, earnings calls, industry reports, expert conversations, Serve's operating data, partner information, and internal technical context - into a defensible point of view and a compelling story (i.e. this role needs to be able to synthesize data, identify opportunities, and develop pithy and compelling pitch). This position supports enterprise and new-vertical opportunities, robotics, data and teleoperation offerings, autonomy adjacencies, and other net-new bets, plus cross-functional strategic inquiries from the broader company. JOB DUTIES Run deep-dive research on target enterprises and markets, covering business model, cost structure, competitive pressures, existing partnerships, technology roadmap, procurement dynamics, and stated strategy. Build market sizing, pricing, cost-to-serve, unit economics, and scenario models from scratch. Build exceptional strategy decks end to end: frame the argument, develop the storyline, select the evidence, and create the charts and slides that make a complex opportunity persuasive to a senior audience. Be equally comfortable producing a three-page partner proposal, a board-level decision slide, or a detailed analytical appendix. Own discrete workstreams on internal strategic questions, including market entry and city sequencing, build-versus-buy-versus-partner analysis, competitive positioning, and capital allocation tradeoffs. Synthesize messy inputs such as public filings, earnings calls, industry reports, expert calls, and Serve's own operating data into a clear point of view with a recommendation attached. Build materials for board, investor, and executive audiences that a senior reader can follow without narration. Track the autonomous delivery, last-mile logistics, robotics, and adjacent mobility landscape, and flag what matters rather than forwarding everything. Evaluate the scale, feasibility, and resource requirements of new bets, including potential revenue or strategic value, partner funding, engineering and operating burden, time to proof, and the milestones that justify further investment, scaling, handoff, or stopping work. Manage a small portfolio of fast-moving workstreams with the Chief Strategy Officer setting priorities; coordinate requests from the Director and other commercial or functional leaders, flag tradeoffs early, and keep critical follow-ups from disappearing between meetings. Deliver useful first answers quickly, then deepen the work where additional precision changes the decision. EXPERIENCE, QUALIFICATIONS, & SKILLS Required Experience, Qualifications, and Skills 3 to 8 years of experience with a meaningful stretch in management consulting, corporate strategy, or similar. Strong research instincts, with demonstrated ability to move from no knowledge of a company to a defensible thesis within roughly a week. Modeling ability in Excel that goes beyond maintaining or formatting someone else's model, including building from scratch and defending every assumption. Slide craft sufficient to build a deck that a C-suite audience can follow without narration. Clear writing, with the ability to construct and defend an argument in prose. Judgment to manage competing priorities across two senior stakeholders and to escalate early when they collide. Comfort with ambiguity and with having a conclusion challenged, then reworking it. Independent thinker. Comfort with big open ended questions is a must-have: “We’ve got 10 product features to prioritize, which one do we do first and why?” or “A company in Europe wants us to do X, should we?” are the kind of questions whomever is in this role should feel comfortable and excited about tackling. Preferred Experience, Qualifications, and Skills MBA or equivalent analytical training Startup, Logistics, last-mile delivery, marketplace, mobility, or robotics exposure. Experience supporting senior executives on high-stakes partner meetings and commercial negotiations at a high-growth company. Previous consulting, banking, or other similar analytically rigorous strategy function, a plus Additional Information The position offers a direct line from analysis to signed commercial agreements alongside standing exposure to the Chief Strategy Officer on questions that shape the company, on a small team with no staffing process. Work is largely self-managed, with shifting priorities and periods of intensity around live pitches, negotiations, board or executive decisions, and new opportunities. Within the first 12 months, success means leadership consistently enters priority meetings with a clear, evidence-backed position; models materially improve pricing, funding, and deal choices; proposals carry a compelling, defensible story; follow-ups and decisions stay organized; and independent recommendations influence which opportunities Serve pursues, funds, scales, hands off, or stops. The position is remote, open across the US and Canada, with light travel of roughly 10% for company gatherings and occasional conferences.
