title: Data Scientist - Product Analytics
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We're looking for a Data Scientist - Product Analytics to join our Growth Data team. You'll own the analysis behind how people discover, adopt and stick with ElevenLabs' products, partnering closely with Product, Growth and the central Data team's certified metrics layer. Define and own product health metrics: activation, feature adoption, retention and engagement across ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI. Design, analyse and communicate the results of product experiments (A/B tests, feature launches, onboarding changes). Partner with Analytics Engineering on the certified product KPI layer in dbt, and with Product on turning ambiguous questions into trusted analysis. Work alongside fellow Growth data scientists on marketing- and revenue-adjacent questions that touch the product funnel. Requirements Demonstrated experience as a data scientist embedded with a product or growth team, ideally at a product-led company. Strong SQL and Python , with hands-on experience in experimentation (A/B testing) and product analytics. Ability to translate ambiguous product questions into clear, reusable analysis and defensible metrics. Comfort working directly with Product and Growth stakeholders , and pushing back on ill-defined asks. Structured thinker who can move fast without sacrificing rigour. Bonus Experience with activation / retention modelling or lifecycle analytics at a consumer or prosumer product. Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse, partnering directly with analytics engineers. Experience using AI tools or agents to speed up analysis or enable self-serve data access. Growth potential We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role: Grow into a Senior or Staff Product Data Scientist role as the Growth Data team scales. Expand scope across additional product lines (ElevenAgents, ElevenAPI). Path into a Growth Data Science lead or broader data leadership track. Location This role is remote-first. title: Senior Computer Vision / Photogrammetry Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Deine Mission Wir sind ein wachsendes PropTech-Startup aus Münster. Unsere KI-gestützte Software ist die Entscheidungsgrundlage für die Immobilienentwicklung. Projektentwickler, Bestandshalter, Banken und Makler nutzen syte, um in Sekunden zu entscheiden, ob, was und wo gebaut, saniert oder gekauft wird. Ausgezeichnet wurden wir mit dem Deutschen KI-Preis 2023 und dem PropTech of the Year Award 2025 des ZIA (Zentraler Immobilien Ausschuss). Heute bildet unsere Plattform auf Basis von über 300 Terabyte Geodaten digitale Zwillinge für 62 Millionen Gebäude und Grundstücke in Deutschland ab. Für den nächsten Sprung, von unseren heutigen Gebäudemodellen zum texturierten LoD3-Gebäude, suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Senior Computer Vision / Photogrammetry Engineer (m/w/d) in Münster oder deutschlandweit remote . Deine Aufgaben: Alle Quellen in einem Modell vereinen: Du kombinierst 2D-Katasterdaten, LiDAR-Punktwolken, Schrägluftbilder, Nadir-Satellitenbilder und weitere Quellen zur genauestmöglichen Abbildung der realen Welt. Unsere 3D-Modelle verbessern: Du bringst Bilddaten und moderne 3D-Rekonstruktionsverfahren in das Produkt, von Multi-View Stereo bis zu Methoden wie Gaussian Splatting und verbesserst damit unsere Gebäudemodelle erheblich. Texturiertes LoD3 erreichen: Du texturierst unsere Modelle aus Schrägluftbildern und erkennst Fenster, Türen und Fassadenelemente. Diese projizierst du konsistent auf die richtige Fläche des richtigen Gebäudes, damit Geschossflächen, Nutzflächen und Oberflächen deutlich präziser berechnet werden können. Mehr aus den Bildern herausholen: Du implementierst Methoden wie Multi-Image Super-Resolution und Occlusion-Aware Reconstruction. So überwindest du begrenzte Bildauflösung und Verdeckungen durch Bäume und andere Objekte. Forschung in die Produktion bringen: Gemeinsam mit unseren Data Engineers, die Pipelines und Plattform verantworten, skalierst du Methoden von einer Handvoll Gebäude auf Millionen. AI-native entwickeln: Du nutzt das volle Potenzial moderner AI-Coding-Tools wie Claude Code und Copilot und identifizierst proaktiv neue KI-Use-Cases im Kontext von Computer Vision und 3D-Rekonstruktion. title: Vulnerability, Accessibility & Inclusion Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍UK Remote | 💰£68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨<br><br>This role is a 13 month secondment to cover caregiver leave within our Vulnerability, Accessibility, Inclusion and Bereavements (VAIB) team in Customer Operations.</p> <p><strong>Our VAIB team⭐</strong></p> <p>Making money work for everyone is what we do at Monzo, but it only counts if it works for the people who need support the most. Our Vulnerability, Accessibility, Inclusion and Bereavements (VAIB) team is dedicated to breaking down barriers across the bank. We make sure that whether a customer is vulnerable, disabled, excluded, or experiencing a bereavement, they get a product and a service that is empathetic, accessible, and built entirely with them in mind.<strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>As our <strong>VAIB Strategy Lead</strong>, you’ll set direction within your area of expertise and turn VAIB priorities into sustainable, well-governed improvements across Monzo.You’ll bring together regulatory requirements, customer insight, data and operational experience to understand where change is needed and help the business deliver it effectively. You’ll work closely with Strategy Managers and Analysts, Operations leaders, Product, Risk, Compliance, Data, Engineering and teams across Monzo. You’ll make sure our strategic priorities are understood, appropriately governed and translated into measurable improvements for customers.</p> <ul> <li>Leading the development, integration and embedment of VAIB strategies, standards and regulatory expectations across Monzo’s products, customer journeys and operational processes. Turning the strategy into clear roadmaps, outcomes and priorities, giving strategic direction to the teams responsible for delivering them.</li> <li>Assessing our products, services and customer support against relevant legal, regulatory and industry standards, identifying gaps, risks and opportunities and driving improvements. As well as horizon scanning, regulatory analysis and gap assessments, turning emerging legal, regulatory and industry developments into practical recommendations for Monzo.</li> <li>Acting as a senior subject matter expert on complex vulnerability, accessibility, inclusion and bereavement issues, including situations where there isn’t an established answer, whilst building VAIB capability across Monzo by sharing your expertise, coaching colleagues and supporting the development of Strategy Managers and Analysts.</li> <li>Working closely with first and second line Risk and Compliance teams to understand regulatory expectations, strengthen governance and controls, and make sure VAIB risks are identified and managed appropriately. Whilst taking ownership of significant VAIB risks, controls, formal actions or remediation programmes where needed, making sure activity is delivered to the right standard.</li> <li>Setting clear expectations and measures for customer outcomes, using data and insight to understand whether our strategies and standards are working and where our approach needs to change.</li> <li>Work closely with Operations and Senior Operations leaders to improve customer support pathways, service standards and outcomes, constructively challenging where performance or strategic alignment falls short.</li> <li>Using complaints, customer insight, operational data and other relevant information to identify systemic barriers or poorer outcomes and turn those findings into strategic action.</li> <li>Working with Product, Operations, Risk, Compliance and other teams to make sure VAIB priorities are understood and embedded in the way we design, deliver and improve products and services.</li> <li>Providing strategic direction on customer communications linked to VAIB, helping make sure information is clear, accessible, accurate and consistent with our approach.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have deep expertise in vulnerability, accessibility, inclusion and bereavement, and understand how to identify and reduce barriers that can prevent people from accessing products and services.</li> <li>You have strong knowledge of the legal, regulatory and industry standards relevant to VAIB, such as FG21, Consumer Duty, the Equality Act 2010, WCAG and the European Accessibility Act, and can turn regulatory requirements, customer insight, data and operational experience into clear strategic priorities and practical recommendations.</li> <li>You have experience developing and embedding strategy at scale, including setting outcomes, roadmaps and measures of success.</li> <li>You’re comfortable working with Risk and Compliance teams and have experience identifying and managing risks, controls, governance requirements or remediation activity.</li> <li>You can provide credible challenge and influence senior stakeholders, including when an issue is complex, ambiguous or there isn’t an established solution.</li> <li>You have experience using customer and operational insight to identify systemic issues and improve customer outcomes.</li> <li>You can work effectively across different teams and disciplines, bringing people together around a clear strategic direction.</li> <li>You enjoy sharing your expertise and helping others build their capability.</li> <li>You’re excited about what we’re doing at Monzo and want to help us make money work for everyone.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £68,400-86,550 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.<br><strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter call (25 minutes)</li> <li>Values & Behaviours Interview (60 minutes)</li> <li>Technical interview with a task (60 minutes)<strong><br><br></strong></li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a><br><br></p> <p>The closing date for applications is 21st October 2026. However, we'll close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>#LI-REMOTE<strong> </strong><strong><br><br></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Analyst, Corporate Development & Strategic Partnerships for portfolio company of K1 Investment Management
description: What is PerfectServe ? PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue. PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians. Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach: In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years. At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward. If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place! Analyst, Corporate Development & Strategic Partnerships for portfolio company of K1 Investment Management Reports to Chief Strategy Officer About PerfectServe PerfectServe builds the clinical communication and scheduling technology that helps physicians, nurses, and care teams deliver faster, safer care. Our cloud-based platform is used by more than 500 hospitals and 40,000+ ambulatory practices across the country, and we are backed by K1 Investment Management as we execute an aggressive growth strategy across both acute and non-acute healthcare markets. We've been at this for nearly 30 years, but we're moving like a company half our age: expanding through M&A, building AI-native products, and forming partnerships that extend our reach into new corners of healthcare. We hold tight to a set of core values, Collaboration, Integrity, Innovation, Service, Purpose, and Inclusion, and we need a diverse team that reflects the communities we serve to build technology that works for everyone. About the Role PerfectServe grows in two connected ways: through acquisitions and partnerships that extend our reach into new markets, and through the relationships with investors, partners, and advisors that make those deals possible. We're looking for a Corporate Development & Partnerships Analyst to support both. A significant part of this role is proactive sourcing: identifying acquisition and partnership targets directly, through research, outreach, and cold calling, rather than relying only on inbound opportunities. This includes finding targets in less obvious places, industry forums, conferences, and online communities, where companies worth a conversation show up before they're on anyone's radar. You'll own the pipeline from first contact, qualifying opportunities and keeping them moving. Alongside this, you'll support our partner ecosystem, channel, and strategic relationships that extend our reach outside of a full acquisition. You'll work directly with the Chief Strategy Officer and have regular interaction with PerfectServe's executive team, our board, our private equity sponsor K1, and outside advisors. This is a strong early-career opportunity to build a foundation in corporate development on a small, high-visibility team. The person who takes it will need to be comfortable with ambiguity and with doing outreach that doesn't always get a response but will get exposure to the full arc of how deals and partnerships get built, with room to grow into greater ownership as they prove themselves. We're looking for someone who is motivated by relationship-building and deal-making and wants to learn corporate development by doing the work firsthand. What You'll Do Sourcing and relationship building Build and maintain a pipeline of acquisition and partnership targets across PerfectServe's core and adjacent markets through proactive, off-market outreach Cold call and cold email owners, founders, and executives at target companies to open relationships and gauge interest, and keep doing it even when most calls don't land Find opportunities that don't come through conventional channels by digging into industry forums, conferences, trade associations, and online communities where smaller or less visible companies surface Keep a disciplined, up-to-date view of every relationship in the pipeline: where it stands, what the next step is, and when to follow up Represent PerfectServe at industry events and conferences to build the relationships that turn into future deal flow Advancing the pipeline Move prospects through the funnel: schedule and help run initial conversations, keep momentum after the first call, and know when and how to push a deal forward Build models and analyses to support deal screening and synergy sizing Support internal due diligence workstreams (commercial, financial, clinical/product, HR, technology) by organizing data requests, synthesizing findings, and flagging risks Draft board and investor-ready materials Help manage the mechanics of a live deal: data rooms, trackers, timelines, and coordination across internal and external workstreams Partner acceleration Maintain a structured view of PerfectServe's partner and channel relationships, including status, next steps, and owner Prepare materials and briefing documents ahead of partner and leadership meetings Support negotiation and documentation of partnership and referral agreements in collaboration with legal and the deal team Help track and report on partnership performance against the commercial case that justified the relationship Cross-functional and investor support Work closely with the CEO, CSO, and functional leaders to gather input and keep strategic initiatives on track Prepare board and investor-ready materials, including decks, one-pagers, and financial summaries Serve as a reliable point of coordination between PerfectServe, K1, and outside advisors on live workstreams What You'll Bring 2+ years of relevant experience, from investment banking, corporate development, sales, business development, or another role where you had to build relationships and move deals or prospects forward A genuine comfort with cold outreach: you don't flinch at calling someone who doesn't know you yet, and you know how to turn a first call into a second one A relationship-builder's instinct: you remember details about people, follow up without being asked, and build trust quickly Competitive, persistent, and resilient; you can make fifty calls, get told no forty-five times, and show up just as sharp on the next one Strong enough financial and analytical fundamentals to build a basic model or synthesize a diligence finding, with the willingness to sharpen those skills fast on the job Excellent written and verbal communication; you can represent PerfectServe credibly to a founder, a banker, or a board member Scrappy, resourceful, and low-ego: willing to do the unglamorous work because you know it's what moves the deal forward High motivation and a genuine hunger to learn how acquisitions and partnerships actually get built, not just modeled Experience or exposure to healthcare, healthcare IT, or SaaS is a plus but not required Why Join PerfectServe? At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You’ll work with a dedicated and mission-driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation. Compensation includes a competitive base salary plus a performance bonus structure, with total earning potential up to $120,000 for candidates who meet or exceed sourcing and deal targets. The compensation range listed for this role reflects our commitment to pay transparency and is based on market data, internal equity, and the scope of responsibilities. compensation will be determined by a combination of factors, including the candidate’s experience, skills, and the specific team or product area they support. We regularly review compensation across the company to ensure fairness and consistency. If you are a current employee and have questions about how your compensation aligns with our ranges, we encourage you to speak with your manager or People Operations. Benefits: Remote first work environment Health, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance options available day one. 401K - with match and immediately vested. 17 company holidays, 2 floating holidays plus competitive paid time off policy Internal Advancement Opportunities PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
description: Flex is a growth-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is creating the best rent payment experience. It’s hard to believe that it’s 2026 and paying rent on time is expensive, inflexible, and difficult. We’re here to change that! Flex enables our users to pay rent throughout the month on a schedule that better fits their finances and budget. Our mission is to empower as many renters as possible with flexibility over their most significant recurring expense. After deliberately keeping a stealth profile as we built up unprecedented investor support and an enthusiastic user base, we are looking for motivated individuals to help us keep our mission growing. Will you be a part of the team? About the role As a Senior SDET at Flex, you will own the test automation and quality efforts for entire product areas or major features. You will architect and optimize automation frameworks, lead test strategy for complex systems, and regularly collaborate across teams to deliver reliable and high-quality releases. This role offers the opportunity to mentor others, drive cross-functional quality improvements, and play a critical part in shaping the future of our engineering excellence. What you’ll do Architect, implement, and optimize automated test frameworks for complex product areas, ensuring high reliability and maintainability Design, develop, and maintain robust automated test suites for API, UI, and integration testing Lead test strategy development and perform risk analysis for major features and systems Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines, supporting continuous integration and delivery processes Proactively identify systemic quality issues and drive cross-team process improvements to increase coverage and efficiency Analyze test coverage, identify gaps, and implement solutions to improve product quality Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and quality leaders on cross-functional quality initiatives and release planning Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior SDETs and QA team members, fostering skill development and best practices Review code and test cases contributed by other engineers for quality and maintainability Maintain accurate and actionable test documentation, reports, and quality metrics for assigned product areas Investigate and resolve complex defects and production issues through advanced debugging and root cause analysis Advocate for quality and champion adoption of best practices within and across engineering teams Proven ability to lead test strategy and risk analysis while making high-impact technical decisions amid ambiguity and prioritizing what matters most. Key qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience 5+ years of experience in software development and test automation Advanced proficiency in multiple programming languages and test automation frameworks Deep experience designing, building, and maintaining automation frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, RestAssured) Strong expertise in API, UI, and integration testing Proficient in CI/CD pipeline integration and optimization Skilled in test strategy development, risk analysis, and test architecture Advanced debugging, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis Solid understanding of database systems and advanced SQL Experience with observability and monitoring tools (e.g., DataDog, NewRelic) Excellent cross-functional communication and mentorship skills Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to collaborate across functions Compensation Flex takes a market-based approach to pay, and compensation may vary depending on your primary work location. Work locations are categorized into one of three tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. The successful candidate’s starting pay will be commensurate with their experience, qualifications, and Flex’s internal leveling guidelines and benchmarks. Tier 1 (NYC/Bay Area, Los Angeles, Seattle) $136,000—$170,000 USD Tier 2 (Austin, Washington D.C. Philadelphia, San Diego, Chicago, Atlanta) $122,400—$153,000 USD Tier 3 (Salt Lake City, all other USA cities) $115,600—$144,500 USD Life at Flex We understand that it takes a diverse team of highly intelligent, curious, determined, empathetic, and self aware people to grow a successful company. Our HQ is located in New York City, but we have employees located throughout the US, Australia, Canada and South America. We are growing quickly, but deliberately, with a focus on building an inclusive culture. Our dynamic team has incredible perspectives to share, just as we know you do, and we take great pride in being an equal opportunity workplace. Offices Roles posted in New York, San Francisco, and Salt Lake City are hybrid positions with on-site expectations of 2-3 days per week in our local offices. For candidates outside of these areas, you may be eligible for our relocation assistance program. Benefits For full-time U.S. employees we offer: Competitive medical, dental, and vision Company equity 401(k) plan with company match Unlimited paid time off + 13 company paid holidays Parental leave Free Flex subscription For full-time non-U.S. employees, we offer: Competitive compensation + company equity Unlimited PTO

This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. title: Senior Marketing Designer
description: Fully Remote (UK based) | Competitive Salary + Bonus + Generous Equity | B Corp Certified TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel. Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world. We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all. But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles. The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you? The Role The title says "marketing designer". The job is much bigger than that. You'll help decide how our brand evolves as we move into bigger markets with bigger ideas. You will be seen as a leader within the TrustedHousesitters creative studio and bring innovative, creative ideas to the table. Our tone is bold, cheeky and a little rebellious, and we want someone who can push that further while keeping the trust our members rely on. This is a hands-on senior role. You'll take work nose to tail, from the first idea to delivering every piece of artwork, with performance data showing how you're doing. What you'll do Take always-on paid social, our biggest acquisition lever, from concept to delivery. That means ads that are funny, bold and different and still hit conversion and engagement benchmarks. Lead creative ideas on your own, pulling together small groups (usually you and a copywriter) and bringing strong, goal-focused concepts back to the senior team Bring the brand to life through motion, animation and video, and take the lead on motion across the studio. Help to support on larger brand activation briefs such as photography, motion shoots and events. Support the Marketing Design Lead on major brand campaign moments, and help develop and evolve our brand look and feel. Design campaign visuals and digital content across paid, organic and owned channels (social, video, landing pages, UGC) Prototype quickly and iterate with modern workflows, including gen AI tools, and lead the studio on tooling. Optimise creative using performance data and leveraging the insights to creatively advertise to our ICPs. Raise the bar on craft through thoughtful peer feedback and light-touch mentoring of more junior studio members. What you'll need Nose-to-tail creative ownership: a track record of turning ideas into finished, multi-format artwork, at pace and on a regular basis Motion and video craft: strong After Effects and Premiere Pro (or equivalent), and a portfolio that shows real motion work, not just static design with a bit of animation Performance creative: hands-on experience designing for paid social and digital ad formats (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, GDN), including vertical, short-form and UGC-style content, and using data to improve results Idea generation: confident developing campaign ideas, not just executing someone else's and being proactive into bringing your own ideas to the senior leadership teams. Range and brand judgement: able to flex into a cheeky, irreverent tone while keeping brand consistency across evolving formats A scale-up mindset: happy to switch from an SLT-level brand moment to a quick asset request in the same week, with no egos and plenty of pace Tools: Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and gen AI tools used in your actual workflow Nice to have On-set or shoot experience (briefing, art direction, working with talent, and bonus points for animals) Experience with digital products, online memberships or trust-based marketplaces Experience at a brand scaling into the US or other international markets A pet, travel or digital product background You'll feel like a fish out of water if: We know this isn't what you'd see in most job ads, but TrustedHousesitters isn't most companies. Trust, transparency and honest feedback aren't just things we say; they're genuinely how we operate, every day. So rather than leaving you guessing if things don't work out, we'd rather give you what you need to make a great decision upfront about whether this opportunity is right for you. With that in mind, here are a few things worth considering before you hit apply: You see seniority as a step away from the smaller stuff. Here, everyone gets stuck in, whatever the size of the brief. You'd rather hand motion off to someone else. Motion is a big part of this role, and we need you to own it. You need a fully formed brief before you start. You'll help shape the idea as much as deliver it. Your work is mostly judged on how it looks. Ours is also judged on how it performs, and we iterate based on the data. Premium and polished is your comfort zone, and cheeky feels off-brand to you. Our voice is bold, playful and a little rebellious. You'd rather stay behind the screen than get involved in shoots and content production. Our hiring process Intro video call with our Talent team Portfolio review with the Creative Studio A short, hypothetical creative task, followed by a conversation about your thinking Compensation Additional Information In addition to a competitive salary and bonus, we offer a range of benefits, including: For the love of pets Each year, you’ll get a Premium TrustedHousesitters Combined membership which includes benefits like free airport lounge passes, Sit Cancellation Plan and Home and Contents Plan, plus five Premium memberships to gift to friends and family Our team can work remotely from as many house sits as they like, and we contribute up to £500 per year towards travel costs to and from sits Find a rescue pet to join your family and we’ll cover the adoption fees, as well as “pawternity” to help your pet settle into their new home Health & wellbeing SimplyHealth healthcare cash plan Bupa Health Insurance and Dental Insurance plan Specsavers eyecare scheme Weekly virtual yoga sessions Optional enrollment onto our Trusted Giving scheme, which includes employee giving via Charities Trust and 2 days paid annual volunteering allowance Working environment Work fully remotely from anywhere in the world - as long as you follow compliance as a UK tax resident Get £200 to spend on home office equipment each year + Macbook and Apple accessories when you start Access to Spaces co-working locations across the globe We host an all-expenses-paid meetup each quarter and fund team events (remote or in-person) throughout the year We cover the costs of personal development resources and have regular time set aside for learning and growth Depending on your role within the business, you’ll have the option to customise your work hours to better align with your personal schedule Compensation & time off 25 days off per year, plus bank holidays and festive closure between Christmas and New Year (36 days + Christmas Day for some roles) Competitive salary which is reviewed annually Generous equity package for permanent employees Discretionary 10% quarterly bonus scheme, distributed quarterly Pension scheme: 5% from you as an employee and 3% from TrustedHousesitters £500 recruitment referral bonus If you're ready to join us on our mission to become the most loved pet travel solution, we'd love to hear from you! In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example- she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc). At the heart of our team are a mix of diverse backgrounds. title: Data Director, EU
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍 London, Barcelona, or UK Remote | 💰 £150,900 to £204,100 + stock options & <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">benefits</a> | ✅ Visa sponsorship & relocation available</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>About our Data Discipline </strong></p> <p>We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. Data is central to how we understand our customers, shape our products, manage risk and grow Monzo sustainably. We believe in empowering teams with high-quality, trusted data and self-serve analytics, while creating space for Data practitioners to focus on the highest-impact questions, opportunities and decisions.</p> <p>Our Data Discipline is deeply embedded in Monzo’s product areas. Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, and Machine Learning Engineers work in cross-functional squads alongside Engineers, Designers, Product Managers and other disciplines. This means Data is not a downstream service, and instead we shape strategy, challenge thinking, build the data foundations teams need to move quickly, and share accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.</p> <p> </p> <h4><strong>Our EU team ⭐</strong></h4> <p>Our EU Data team is a full-stack Data team, and together we're building Monzo's presence across Europe from the ground up. We're entering new markets, learning what customers in each one need and finding product-market fit for Monzo. </p> <p> </p> <p>Our mission is to make money work for everyone, everywhere. As Data Director for EU expansion you'll lead the Data team and shape our product strategy as we grow, deciding where we place our bets, working out what to measure before there's a playbook, and making sure each new market learns fast enough to compound into the next.</p> <p> </p> <p>You'll work closely with EU leadership (our EU CEO, Country Managers and VP of Product) and Monzo's global Leadership team (the CTO, Head of Data and other Data Directors), sitting on the EU Tech Leadership team and helping shape our global data strategy. To do this well you'll need to relish ambiguity, bringing analytical rigour and commercial judgement to bets that often have to be made before the data is complete.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>You'll own the full learning loop that EU expansion runs on, and you'll co-own the product development loop alongside EU Leadership, Product and Engineering. In a new market that often means building those loops from scratch, so you're accountable not just for measuring what happens, but for framing the questions, defining what good looks like, and building the systems that answer them. You'll be a senior voice on the EU Tech Leadership team, the person who reframes the hard problems and puts a number on the trade-off between what's valuable for customers and what's valuable for the business.</p> <p><em>Shaping product and commercial strategy:</em></p> <ul> <li>You'll decide where Monzo should bet as we enter each new European market, sizing the opportunity and finding product-market fit for the products and segments most likely to win.</li> <li>You'll use sharp commercial judgement to work through the ambiguity of building in a new market, from pricing and positioning to the levers that drive growth, bringing Data into strategy early so we shape priorities rather than react to decisions already made.</li> </ul> <p><em>Owning the data strategy and the learning loops:</em></p> <ul> <li>You'll set the data strategy for EU and stand up the foundations each new market needs, from the events we log and the metrics and experiments we design to the forecasts markets learn from.</li> <li>Lead the goal-setting process for EU Expansion, bringing clarity to metric selection and target setting, in close partnership with Finance.</li> </ul> <p><em>Changing how decisions get made:</em></p> <ul> <li>You'll represent Data directly at the ExCo level, building a shared language of metrics and analytical reasoning so that Data drives EU strategy rather than reporting on it.</li> <li>You'll drive cross-collective collaboration, spotting the high-leverage connections across the business, for example how savings features drive engagement in our Wealth collective.</li> </ul> <p><em>Building and leading a high-performing team:</em></p> <ul> <li>You'll build, grow and retain a high-performing, full-stack Data team, where everyone shares accountability for product and business outcomes.</li> <li>You'll raise the performance bar, develop the next generation of Data leaders, and model an inclusive, high-craft Data culture as we scale.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <p>What we're doing here at Monzo excites you, and the idea of helping take it across Europe especially so!</p> <ul> <li>You're a strategic data leader who has operated at Director level or above, and you're energised by zero-to-one ambiguity, having built or scaled a data function in a new market, product line or business from an early stage.</li> <li>You move comfortably from detailed metrics and data architecture to customer strategy, commercial outcomes and product-market fit, and you're happy to be the opinionated voice in the room that reframes the trade-off.</li> <li>You lead through learning loops and hold a high technical bar, because you've built or owned the measurement a business relies on to set goals, run experiments and improve, with the judgement to know which methods and investments will pay off.</li> <li>You have experience leading company-wide or division-wide goal-setting, defining high-clarity metrics, setting targets and partnering closely with Finance.</li> <li>You change how organisations make decisions, not just how one project turns out, and you have experience of the cross-collective collaboration that connects the dots across different business areas.</li> <li>You're an empathetic people leader who has grown full-stack Data teams of both individual contributors and managers, comfortable representing Data at ExCo and to C-level peers, and you know what it takes to attract, develop and retain top talent.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>30 minute recruiter call</li> <li>45 minute call with the hiring manager</li> <li>4 x 1-hour video calls with various team members, including the General Manager for Payments</li> <li>A meet and greet with a member of EU Executive Committee</li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £150,900 to £204,100 + stock options and<a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"> benefits </a></p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London or Barcelona office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team</p> <p>📚 Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-JH1  #LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h3>An overview of this role</h3> <p>As an <span class="textBold">Engineering Manager</span>, you’ll guide GitLab’s dedicated <span class="textBold">Software Supply Chain Security (SSCS) Add-On</span> engineering team as it develops core capabilities including <span class="textBold">Dependency Firewall, Build Provenance, Malicious Packages detection, and Artifact Signing</span>. This is a founding management role where you’ll help shape how the team works, partner closely with the Staff Backend Engineer, Product Manager, and SSCS stage management, and turn a defined roadmap into steady, high-quality delivery for enterprise customers with strict security and compliance needs. You’ll focus on developing the team, creating a healthy operating rhythm, and establishing predictable execution for the SSCS SKU.</p> <p>You’ll join a product area where customers in regulated industries are already validating the need, and your work will help GitLab deliver software supply chain security features that customers can rely on. While technical credibility matters, your main focus will be growing a strong backend engineering team, enabling team members in their development, and creating the conditions for long-term delivery and quality.</p> <h3>What you’ll do</h3> <ul> <li value="1"><span class="textBold">Guide</span> a backend engineering team building the SSCS Add-On across dependency enforcement, build provenance, malicious package detection, and artifact signing.</li> <li value="2"><span class="textBold">Be responsible for</span> <span class="textBold">Drive</span> engineering delivery for general availability milestones by aligning sequencing, scope, and dependencies with the Staff Backend Engineer and Product Manager.</li> <li value="3"><span class="textBold">Develop</span> the team by partnering with Talent Acquisition on sourcing, interview design, candidate evaluation, and hiring decisions.</li> <li value="4"><span class="textBold">Run</span> regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development conversations that enable growth and clear expectations.</li> <li value="5"><span class="textBold">Advance</span> engineering quality by monitoring cycle time, defect rates, and test coverage, and by addressing risks early.</li> <li value="6"><span class="textBold">Coordinate</span> quarterly planning and roadmap tradeoff discussions with SSCS stage leadership and Product.</li> <li value="7"><span class="textBold">Work with</span> Finance and other partners on headcount pacing and team planning as the Add-On scales.</li> <li value="8"><span class="textBold">Represent</span> the SSCS Add-On team within stage leadership discussions and help ensure strong communication across functions.</li> </ul> <h3>What you’ll bring</h3> <ul> <li value="1"><span class="textBold">Over 3 years of experience guiding</span> backend product engineering teams in security, DevOps, or platform engineering environments.</li> <li value="2"><span class="textBold">Ability to hire and grow</span> backend or security engineers in distributed team environments, with practical understanding of the talent landscape for these roles.</li> <li value="3"><span class="textBold">Technical credibility</span> to contribute to architecture discussions involving package registries, CI/CD pipeline security, and signing infrastructure.</li> <li value="4"><span class="textBold">Experience managing</span> predictable delivery across multi-quarter product roadmaps and managing cross-team dependencies.</li> <li value="5"><span class="textBold">Comfort working</span> in an asynchronous, documentation-driven organization with clear written communication.</li> <li value="6"><span class="textBold">Familiarity with</span> supply chain security, artifact management, or compliance-focused product areas, or transferable experience from related domains.</li> <li value="7"><span class="textBold">Working knowledge of</span> concepts related to frameworks and ecosystems such as SLSA and Sigstore.</li> <li value="8"><span class="textBold">Ability to build credibility</span> with engineers, product partners, and customer-facing stakeholders through clear judgment, coaching, and teamwork.</li> </ul> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>The <span class="textBold">SSCS Add-On team</span> is a product engineering team within GitLab’s <span class="textBold">Software Supply Chain Security</span> stage. We work on key capabilities in the SSCS Add-On SKU and collaborate closely with product and engineering partners to deliver security features for customers operating in regulated environments. You’ll report to the SSCS Senior Engineering Manager and partner directly with the Staff Backend Engineer and Product Manager. As a distributed team working asynchronously across regions, we are focused on strong delivery practices, team health, and scaling the product area with clarity and accountability. For more on how related teams work, see <a class="textLink" href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/development/sec/software-supply-chain-security/pipeline-security/" target="_blank">Team Handbook Page</a>.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. title: Founding Product Designer
description: Germany - EU Remote (CET preferred) · German & English · Full-time Competitive salary · Early equity www.3ive.ai About Us A software engineer today works alongside Claude Code or Cursor. A mechanical engineer designing the next car component still clicks through CAD trees, up to 7 different softwares and searches Excel sheets, Windows folders and asks whoever has been around longest. AI is about to change that fundamentally – and nobody has figured out yet what the interface for it looks like. That is why we are building the AI co-engineer for physical products: agents that work natively in 3D, sit on top of CATIA, NX, SOLIDWORKS and Creo, and learn from real-world engineering decisions. We are already in production with major European manufacturers. 🔍 Who we're looking for We are a small, AI-native team and we need a senior designer who defines how engineers and AI agents work together in 3D. You own product design end-to-end and take on a real share of product management (~30%) together with the founders. You have designed complex B2B / SaaS products – dense data, multi-step workflows, expert users who don't forgive friction You have shipped AI and agent experiences – not just chat, but human-in-the-loop review, uncertainty, and making an agent's reasoning traceable You prototype in code – and put working prototypes in front of users, not just Figma frames You think like a product manager – you run user interviews, write crisp specs, prioritise ruthlessly and work directly with engineers You combine taste with pragmatism – you know when to polish and when to ship You are fluent in German and English – our users are engineers at German manufacturers and you will talk to them directly Experience with 3D, CAD, PLM or other engineering software – ideally in a startup – is a strong plus. 🏗️ What you'll work on You will shape the future of agentic 3D design and engineering . There is no pattern library for this category yet – you will write it. What that looks like right now: Designing how an engineer briefs, steers and reviews an AI agent that generates and modifies 3D designs – from a customer request to a validated design variant Making agent work inspectable in 3D – viewers, cuts, measurements, 2D drawings, and a clear view of what the agent changed and why Turning a fast-grown product into a coherent design system together with our frontend engineers Running research loops with engineers at automotive and industrial customers and turning them into roadmap, specs and shipped features We work with Figma, Flowbite, Linear and a modern Python and TypeScript stack – and we prototype with AI every day. ✨ Why join Define the interaction model for a category that does not exist yet Real enterprise customers , real revenue, real problems - not a solution looking for a market Direct line to the founders – product vision and design decisions happen in the same conversation Remote across Europe with in-person client workshops and team offsites Competitive salary and meaningful early equity 📩 How to apply Via Ashby with: Your CV Your portfolio – at least two case studies of complex B2B or AI products, showing your process, not just final screens A link to something you prototyped in code A 2-min intro video (any format you like) A short answer to: "What is the most complex workflow you have simplified – what made it hard, and what did you decide to leave out?" title: Staff Product Manager: Product Discovery Engine
description: Staff Product Manager, Product Discovery Engine About Us Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you’ve probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We’re approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We’re a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things. Job Summary We’re looking for a systems-minded Staff Product Manager to take Constructor’s search and discovery to the state of the art — and keep it there — across every retail industry we serve. This is a highly technical, high-leverage role at the core of our Product Discovery Engine chapter: the teams responsible for how we retrieve, understand, and rank the right products for every shopper, on every query, for every customer. Your job is to raise discovery quality and, through it, our customers’ business metrics. You won’t be measured on features shipped — you’ll be measured on relevance and business outcomes, like conversion, revenue per visit, and search-attributed GMV, moving up. You’ll start embedded with our Search Quality team, owning its strategy and roadmap and getting deep into the systems that decide what shoppers actually see. Over time, your mandate grows to setting direction for the entire Product Discovery Engine chapter — deciding where we’re heading and why across recall, ranking, query understanding, personalization, and the ML infrastructure underneath. This is a Staff role today with a clear path to Director as you take on chapter-wide leadership. Search at Constructor is fundamentally a machine learning problem, so this role lives and breathes ML. You’ll partner closely with ML, data science, and engineering to turn the latest research into production wins, keep us ahead of both commercial competitors and academic state of the art, and be the connective tissue that aligns multiple teams — ML Recall, ML Infra, and, over time, teams like CORE, SABR, and Catalog Management — behind a single, coherent vision for great discovery. If you’re excited about driving innovation across dozens of the world’s largest retailers, being held to relevance and business outcomes, and pushing an already best-in-class product further ahead, this role is for you. What You’ll Do Own business impact, not features. Drive measurable lift in search-attributed conversion, revenue per visit, and GMV alongside relevance across our customer base. Deliver across every retail industry. Move quality and business metrics across all the verticals we serve, accounting for the differences in catalog, language, and shopper intent. Keep us at the state of the art. Continuously translate the latest ML / IR research and competitive moves into production wins, and ship SOTA ML / LLM-assisted capabilities that beat our previous best on relevance. Set chapter vision and strategy. Define the multi-quarter direction for the Product Discovery Engine — where we’re heading and why — tie it directly to customer business outcomes, and rally teams behind it. Lead Search Quality first. Own its strategy and roadmap, driving measurable improvements in the relevance and correctness of results. Orchestrate across the pipeline. Unify recall, ranking, query understanding, and personalization behind one definition of quality and one set of business metrics, so improvements compound instead of colliding. Turn ML research into production wins. Partner deeply with ML and data science to take models — from candidate generation and recall to LLM-assisted interpretation — from idea to production, balancing accuracy, latency, and cost. Make quality measurable and explainable. Build the metrics, evaluation frameworks, and tooling the whole chapter uses to measure, attribute, and explain discovery quality and its business impact. Own quality under pressure. Lead investigation and triage when issues arise, and design durable, systemic fixes rather than one-off patches. Grow the mandate. description: Jobbeschreibung Du studierst und willst nicht nur Theorie pauken, sondern echte Vertriebspraxis sammeln? Unser Team ist so vielfältig wie unsere Ideen: Menschen aus über 40 verschiedenen Ländern arbeiten bei uns gemeinsam an einer Vision. Was uns verbindet, sind unsere Werte, unser Antrieb und unser Anspruch, wirklich etwas zu bewegen. Wir sind keine großen Redner: wir sind Macher. We love to perform . Mit unserem Wachstum bauen wir unsere Teams gezielt und nachhaltig aus und suchen Persönlichkeiten, die Verantwortung übernehmen, mitdenken und mit uns die Zukunft gestalten. Dein neuer Studijob Unterstütze unser Sales-Team dabei, neue Vendoren zu gewinnen und bestehende Leads weiterzuentwickeln! Lead-Qualifizierung & Onboarding-Anfragen: Du bearbeitest eingehende Leads und Paid-Onboarding-Anfragen eigenständig, führst erste Discovery- und Qualifizierungsgespräche und sorgst dafür, dass vielversprechende Kontakte strukturiert an die Account Executives übergeben werden. Dabei lernst du direkt, worauf es bei der Bewertung von Vertriebschancen wirklich ankommt. Outbound-Kampagnen & Vendor-Ansprache: Du unterstützt aktiv bei der Ansprache neuer Vendoren und bringst dich in laufende Outbound-Kampagnen ein. Du lernst, wie man gezielt potenzielle Partner identifiziert, anspricht und für Digistore24 begeistert. Generell bringst du eine hohe digitale Affinität mit, arbeitest sicher mit Google Workspace und CRM-Systemen und interessierst dich für B2B SaaS, Software und digitale Geschäftsmodelle. Dieser Job ist NICHT für dich geeignet, wenn du … kein immatrikulierter Student bist. ... deinen Wohnsitz nicht in Deutschland hast. … nicht für mindestens 20 Stunden an mindestens vier Tagen pro Woche verfügbar bist. … keinen Spaß daran hast, mit Menschen zu kommunizieren und aktiv auf potenzielle Kunden zuzugehen. … nicht fließend Deutsch (C2) und Englisch (mind. B2) in Wort und Schrift beherrschst (beide Sprachen sind Voraussetzung für diese Rolle). … schnelle Veränderungen und neue Herausforderungen lieber vermeidest. … ausschließlich administrative Aufgaben übernehmen möchtest und kein Interesse an echtem Vertrieb hast. … wenig Eigeninitiative mitbringst und darauf wartest, dass dir jede Aufgabe vorgegeben wird. … keine Lust darauf hast, KI-Tools aktiv in deinen Arbeitsalltag zu integrieren , neue Lösungen auszuprobieren und bestehende Arbeitsweisen zu hinterfragen. ... dich nicht mit unseren identifizierst. Deine Benefits bei Digistore24 Du erledigst nicht nur einen 08/15-Studijob, sondern wirst Teil eines großartigen Remote-Teams, wenn du dich langfristig entwickeln willst! 100 % Remote: Arbeite dauerhaft von zu Hause aus. Alles, was du brauchst, ist eine stabile Internetverbindung. Arbeite bis zu 170 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU-Ausland ! (Weitere Länder nach Absprache möglich). Nutze bis zu 3 Tage pro Woche die Coworking-Spaces unseres Partners. Wir bieten dir 24 Urlaubstage im Jahr (auf Basis einer 5-Tage-Woche). Keine starren Entwicklungspläne: Deine Weiterentwicklung richtet sich individuell nach deinen Stärken. On the job setzt du dich mit modernen und relevanten Themen auseinander. Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege: Die Stabilität eines extrem erfolgreichen deutschen Hightech-Unternehmens, das sich seinen Start-Up-Spirit über die Jahre bewahrt hat. Unsere Founder sind Teil unseres Teams: wir agieren ohne externe Investoren aus eigener Kraft und reinvestieren alles, was wir erwirtschaften. Selbstbestimmte, ergebnisorientierte Teams: Arbeite in einer Unternehmenskultur, die auf Eigenverantwortung, Autonomie und direktes Feedback setzt, statt auf Micromanagement. Du erhältst von uns modernes Equipment für deine Arbeit. Internationale, kollaborative Kultur: Arbeite mit einem internationalen Team aus engagierten, klugen Köpfen zusammen. Echte menschliche Verbindung: Erlebe spektakuläre Team-Events in ganz Europa und baue Beziehungen auf, die über Bildschirme hinausgehen. Ownership vom ersten Tag an: Bei uns bist du kein Rädchen im System, sondern ein wichtiger Teil eines A-Player-Teams und wirst von der Teamleitung persönlich gefördert (und gechallenged!), unter anderem in monatlichen One-on-One-Gesprächen. Arbeite in deinem Team per du, ohne Dresscode und auf Augenhöhe. Team Lunches mit Lieferando-Guthaben. Eigenverantwortliche Aufgabenbereiche und direkte Einbindung von Tag 1 an. Planbare Stundenanzahl und abgestimmte Arbeitszeiten, die sich mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen. Attraktiver Stundenlohn in Höhe von 17 € brutto. So sieht dein typischer Tag bei Digistore24 aus: Start mit Überblick: Du öffnest HubSpot, verschaffst dir einen Überblick über neue Leads und offene Anfragen, priorisierst deine Aufgaben und bereitest deine Gespräche für den Tag vor. Leads qualifizieren: Du führst erste Discovery- oder Qualifizierungsgespräche mit kleineren Leads, stellst die richtigen Fragen, erkennst das Potenzial und dokumentierst alles sauber im CRM. AI First in der Praxis: Dir fällt auf, dass eine wiederkehrende Aufgabe unnötig viel manuelle Arbeit verursacht. Statt sie einfach weiter abzuarbeiten, überlegst du, wie du sie mit KI vereinfachen oder automatisieren kannst. Du testest einen Ansatz, holst dir Feedback aus dem Team und entwickelst daraus im besten Fall eine Lösung, die euch künftig Zeit spart. Jetzt steht ein virtueller Kaffee-Call an: Die nächsten 15 Minuten sind für einen entspannten Austausch beim Kaffee mit einer Teamkollegin reserviert. Gemeinsam vorankommen: Du arbeitest mit den Account Executives an laufenden Sales-Projekten, unterstützt Outbound-Kampagnen oder bringst dich in aktuelle Growth-Initiativen ein. Sauberer Abschluss: Du aktualisierst HubSpot, stimmst dich kurz mit dem Team ab und stellst sicher, dass alle Leads korrekt übergeben oder nachverfolgt werden. Mit einem guten Gefühl gehst du in den Feierabend und hast den Rest des Tages noch Zeit für dein Studium. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Product Owner (m/w/d)
description: Was wir suchen Jedes Unternehmen braucht laufend neue Kunden – und genau dieses Problem lösen wir. Mit Interlead bauen die wir #1 Plattform für Leads, Termine und Aufträge und machen die Kundengewinnung für unsere Partner damit einfacher, transparenter und planbarer. Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir daher einen Product Owner (m/w/d) für unser Tech Team (hybrid/remote). Das sind deine Aufgaben Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Lead-Marktplatz-Software – unserer eigens entwickelten Kernanwendung zur automatisierten Neukundengewinnung. Du sorgst dafür, dass die Entwicklung reibungslos voranschreitet und unsere Entwickler jederzeit an den richtigen Prioritäten arbeiten. Du konzipierst eigenständig neue Features, nimmst Anforderungen aus den Fachabteilungen und von Usern auf und übersetzt sie in klare Arbeitspakete (z. B. Tickets, Mockups etc.). Du prüfst neue Features auf Funktionalität und Qualität, begleitest den Release-Prozess und verantwortest den Live-Gang. Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen I T, Fachabteilungen und externen Dienstleistern und sorgst während des gesamten Entwicklungsprozesses für eine transparente Kommunikation. Du hältst alle relevanten Stakeholder regelmäßig über den aktuellen Entwicklungsstand auf dem Laufenden. Du identifizierst, konzipierst und implementierst AI-Anwendungen , die unsere Softwarelösungen und internen Prozesse intelligenter und effizienter machen – von der ersten Idee bis zum produktiven Einsatz. Dank deiner Expertise erreichst du folgende Meilensteine bei uns 0–3 Monate: Du lernst die Leadbase (Matching, Dialer, Partner-Portal, Versand & Abrechnung sowie APIs) und die wichtigsten Stakeholder aus Vertrieb, Operations und Tech kennen. Du übernimmst die Pflege des Backlogs sowie die laufende Priorisierung der Tickets im Tech-Team. Du setzt erste kleinere Verbesserungen eigenständig um – von der Anforderungsaufnahme über die Qualitätssicherung bis zum Live-Gang. Du etablierst regelmäßige Kommunikationsformate (z. B. wöchentliche Status-Updates oder Release Notes) und hältst Fachabteilungen sowie Management über den Entwicklungsstand auf dem Laufenden. 4–6 Monate: Du verantwortest eigenständig ein größeres Feature oder eine Produktinitiative der Leadbase – von der Konzeption bis zum erfolgreichen Rollout. Du stehst im regelmäßigen Austausch mit den Fachbereichen und priorisierst Anforderungen nach ihrem Nutzen und ihrer Relevanz. Du identifizierst konkrete Einsatzmöglichkeiten für KI und setzt erste Prozessoptimierungen um (z. B. zur Automatisierung von Anforderungsprozessen oder zur Steigerung der internen Produktivität). 7–12 Monate: Du gestaltest die Produktstrategie für Lead Matching und angrenzende Module (z. B. Dialer, Multi-Channel und Partner-API) aktiv mit und bringst mindestens ein strategisches Vorhaben erfolgreich in Produktion. Du hast mindestens eine KI-Lösung erfolgreich produktiv eingeführt. Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für Produktfragen rund um die Leadbase und wirst von Fachabteilungen sowie externen Partnern als verlässliche Schnittstelle wahrgenommen. Das bringst du mit Du bringst Erfahrung als Product Owner oder Product Manager in einem agilen Umfeld mit – idealerweise in einem SaaS- oder Tech-Unternehmen. Du verfügst über ein gutes technisches Verständnis und hast Freude daran, die Brücke zwischen Business und Entwicklung zu schlagen. Du hast erste Berührungspunkte mit künstlicher Intelligenz oder ein fundiertes Interesse daran, KI-Lösungen praxisnah im Unternehmenskontext einzusetzen. Du arbeitest strukturiert und proaktiv und kannst komplexe Anforderungen in klare Aufgaben und Prioritäten übersetzen. Du kommunizierst sicher und verständlich – auch bei technischen Themen und mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern. Du begeisterst dich für datengetriebene, digitale Produkte und hast den Anspruch, Dinge aktiv voranzubringen und nachhaltig zu verbessern. paid acquisition across channels, including search, display, paid social, and retargeting. • Optimize CAC, payback period, and channel ROI through continuous experimentation and data-driven iteration. acquisition through technical SEO, structured content, and site optimization • Build visibility across AI-driven discovery platforms such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini through Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) Product, Brand & Content Strategy • Develop and execute a clear product and brand marketing strategy that drives awareness, revenue, and sales enablement • Collaborate on product launches, crafting compelling messaging and providing materials to support Sales and partners • Drive Flex’s narrative through high-impact content across website copy, campaigns, organic, paid, email, press, and referral channels What You Bring • 6–10+ years of experience in growth, digital, or performance marketing, ideally in FinTech or a B2B SaaS environment • 3+ years of people management
