title: Credit Risk Oversight Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£79,900 - £95,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨</p> <p><strong>Our Credit Oversight team⭐</strong></p> <p>Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and with the planned launch of new initiatives. As our lending portfolio grows, our second line of defence Credit Risk Oversight team is growing with it - and we’re looking for a Credit Risk Oversight Manager to join us!</p> <p>Our Credit Risk Oversight team is crucial in providing support and challenge to our Borrowing teams in the first line of defence to help Monzo grow safely. We’re looking for someone (maybe you?!) with proven experience in consumer credit risk who likes getting into the details and analysing data to deliver independent assurance - and challenge - of credit risk management across the lifecycle. </p> <p>Ideally you’ll have experience and in-depth knowledge of retail unsecured or small business credit risk strategy within financial services. You’ll have seen first-hand how a credit portfolio performs at different stages of the credit cycle, and have hands-on experience in shaping or overseeing lending strategies. You’ll have a collaborative approach, and be comfortable working across a broad range of stakeholders. You’ll also be someone who likes getting into the details, analysing data and providing constructive challenges.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p><strong>Providing ongoing oversight of credit risk - this includes analysing and understanding the performance of our existing lending products, developing and enhancing monitoring metrics and providing input to relevant committees and forums  </strong></p> <ul> <li>Partnering with our first line of defence teams to support credit strategy changes - including new product launches and pilots - ensuring that we deliver magical lending products for our customers while meeting our Risk Appetite</li> <li>Delivering deep insight, feedback and challenge on our credit strategies - including data-driven analysis and actionable counter-proposals - to support management decision making and shaping better outcomes for our customers</li> <li>Leading second line assurance work on thematic reviews</li> <li>Collaborating with our model validation and model development teams to ensure understanding of the models that underpin our credit strategies</li> <li>Providing credit expertise and input into relevant strategic projects and critical Monzo-wide processes, such as stress-testing and forecasting</li> <li>Supporting us in maintaining our Credit Risk Framework and making sure it is well embedded within the business</li> <li>Taking a balanced and proportionate approach to risk management, making sure that managing risks becomes part of everyone at Monzo’s day-to-day role</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if you …</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have a strong background in credit risk management within consumer or small business lending - experience in unsecured product, such as credit cards, loans or overdrafts would be particularly beneficial</li> <li>Have proven analytical skills, and can use these to interrogate data, build monitoring and look for early indicators of trends</li> <li>Have hands-on experience and/or understanding of how to use credit risk scorecards and NPV models to develop strategies for making credit decisions</li> <li>Have a solid technical toolkit; SQL or similar is a must-have, and experience using a data visualisation tool (such as Looker, PowerBI or Tableau) is a plus</li> <li>Are excited to explore how we can use AI tools to improve our credit and risk management processes</li> <li>Can convey problems and solutions using clear and simple language, both written and verbal (see <a href="https://monzo.com/tone-of-voice/">Monzo’s tone of voice</a> guide). This is particularly important for communicating complex issues and priorities to non-experts</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Have a track record of building and maintaining trusting relationships with stakeholders, while providing effective and respectful challenge</li> <li>Are passionate about technology, and what we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply - even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £79,900-95,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>An initial call with our recruiter</li> <li>A call with one of our Credit Risk Oversight Managers, the hiring manager(s) for the role </li> <li>A take-home task</li> <li>Two competency, based interviews - one role specific technical interview and one behaviours and values interview</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 4-8 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>#LI-TK1<strong><br><br></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Director Payment Integrity
description: Job Title: Director, Payment Integrity Reports To: Vice President, Operations This is an exempt position reporting to the Vice President, Operations. The Director of Payment Integrity is responsible for the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams. This role functions as both the director setting strategy for these departments and the direct supervisor managing day to day operations. This position interfaces with all departments of SIHO as well as external stakeholders, vendors, and customers. actionable insights Manage data transfers with vendor partners, meet with vendors regularly to ensure processes are working as intended, and escalate potential issues as they arise Interact directly with customers as needed Work with SIHO Legal and key leadership on special cases and external inquiries from CMS, the Indiana Department of Insurance, law enforcement, and others Develop, maintain, and report statistical measurements assessing the effectiveness of the QA, FWA, and G&A programs Lead or support key corporate and departmental compliance initiatives, including SOC audits, CMS Part C Reporting and ODAG, and others as assigned Minimum Skills Requirement: B.S. degree or equivalent work experience in a healthcare operation 3-5 years experience in a managed care environment Strong group/TPA, and MEWA products preferred Demonstrated ability to lead and manage people and teams, while also directly supervising staff on a daily basis Proficient in Excel with the ability to analyze data and draw actionable insights Thorough understanding of medical and health plan terminology; familiarity with CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding a plus Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate with all levels of management as well as external entities, vendors, and customers Ability to work successfully at a self-directed pace in a changing, fast-paced, high demand environment, adapting quickly between competing high priority items Ability to work successfully under tight deadlines Experience with SIHO systems including the HSP claims system Proficient in Microsoft Office suite products including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook All positions are subject to change based on the needs of the business. \n \n Please mention the No holidays/time off will be authorised during this period.<br><br></p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰£31,100 - £39,350 (+ £2,500 Multilingual Premium) + Incentive awards tied to your performance</p> <p>🎂 We guarantee to approve time off on your birthday if it falls on a day you’re scheduled to work and it’s outside of your training period.</p> <p>📍 This role is remote based in the UK.</p> <p>📚£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.<br><br></p> <p><strong>🌈 Ready to join the Monzo adventure?</strong></p> <p>Apply now and help us make money work for everyone in the EU!<br><br></p> <p><strong>The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Application questions</li> <li>Call with a Recruiter</li> <li>Take home task to assess your financial crime knowledge</li> <li>Interview to discuss your previous experience and technical knowledge and values & language assessment</li> </ul> <p>We want you to feel confident and put your best foot forward during the interview process. You will be ensuring that models are fit for purpose, appropriately governed, explainable and performing as expected</li> <li>Supporting oversight and validation of broader credit risk models, including IFRS9, stress testing and economic response models</li> <li>Developing deep understanding of Monzo’s credit models, and using this to provide impactful input and challenge to model developers to improve our modelling capabilities</li> <li>Reviewing ongoing model performance monitoring to ensure our lending models perform within our risk thresholds, and providing support to our first line of defence teams when action is required</li> <li>Performing statistical analyses to independently assess model performance, including developing challenger models where appropriate to test model assumptions and strengthen validation conclusions</li> <li>Improving our Model Risk Framework, including overseeing our policies, standards and procedures to help embed best practice across the business. This means making sure we follow up-to-date regulatory guidelines, and adapt our processes to make sure they remain relevant as modelling techniques evolve</li> <li>Writing clear and impactful model validation reports, and presenting the findings and actions in relevant committees</li> <li>Partnering with colleagues in the first line of defence credit strategy and modelling teams - and wider risk teams across Monzo - to support the embedding of our model risk framework and establishing consistent validation standards across the organisation</li> <li>Embracing new and innovative technology, including leading the adoption of AI tools to enhance our model validation approach</li> </ul> <p><strong> 🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have a strong background and practical experience in credit model development and/or validation - in particular with exposure to machine learning or statistical models used in credit decisioning, such as decision science scorecards, origination / underwriting PD models, and NPV / unit economics modelling</li> <li>Are data driven, with strong analytical skills and deep understanding of statistical techniques for credit and model risk. Being able to get hands on with data is critical - so strong SQL and Python skills are essential, and experience with data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Looker or similar is a plus!</li> <li>Understand how models are used in real-time decisioning and lending strategies, and how to balance commercial and risk outcomes</li> <li>Have strong written and verbal communication skills, and are able to articulate problems and solutions using clear and simple language. We aim to create a genuine feel-good factor when it comes to personal credit, and are looking for driven, analytical and creative individuals to help us achieve this goal.</p> <p>With our Flex product we’re reinventing credit cards to give customers more visibility and control over their spending. With our Flex product, we’re reinventing credit cards to give customers more visibility and control over their spending. Flex portfolio management is currently in its infancy—meaning this role is a true "zero-to-one" blank canvas. Flex behaves differently from a standard credit card, so we are looking for a highly strategic Credit Risk Manager who can challenge legacy banking assumptions, think from first principles, and put the customer at the heart of our lifecycle strategies.</p> <p>You will lead an initial team of 3 credit analysts (with scope to grow the team over time) to unlock massive P&L and customer engagement potential on a rapidly growing portfolio. Data-Driven Loss Mitigation:</strong> Develop proactive risk management frameworks—such as credit limit decrease strategies—to safely mitigate losses and support financially vulnerable customers.</li> Engineering, Design, Marketing, Customer Research, and Risk & Control.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional Leadership:</strong> Build deep collaborative ties with wider credit functions and manage even if you’re nearby. You’ll have the freedom to work in a way that fits your life, whether that’s school drop-offs, avoiding rush hour, or making time for what matters most.</p> <p>Work the way that works for you at Monzo! 💼</p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <p>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</p> <ul> <li><strong>You are a commercial, strategic credit leader</strong> with a deep understanding of unsecured lending portfolios—ideally with exposure to credit card lifecycle management.</li> <li><strong>You thrive in ambiguous, "zero-to-one" environments.</strong> You love building strategies from scratch, questioning traditional banking norms, and working at pace.</li> <li><strong>You have portfolio management experience, </strong>including risk-based pricing, retention, product upgrades, and loss mitigation strategies.</li> <li><strong>You are a champion for both Credit and Conduct Risk.</strong> You naturally balance sharp credit instincts with a passion for protecting customers and delivering delightful experiences.</li> <li><strong>You are an exceptional stakeholder manager and storyteller.</strong> You can smoothly collaborate with engineering squads, align with legal and compliance partners, and influence up to executive leadership.</li> <li><strong>You love developing people.</strong> You have a proven track record of leading analytical talent and are energized by the prospect of managing and growing a high-impact team.</li> <li><strong>You have strong technical and data capabilities.</strong> You are comfortable digging into data yourself and driving a data-first culture (SQL is a must-have; Python and Looker experience is a plus).</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Interview Process:</strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves 3 main stages. title: Director of Data, Payments

Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers and Analysts work in cross-functional squads alongside Engineers, Designers, Product Managers, Marketers and other specialists. This means Data is not a downstream service: we help shape strategy, challenge thinking, build the data foundations teams need to move quickly, and share accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.</p> <h2><strong>Our Payments team ⭐</strong></h2> <p>At Monzo, payments are more than just moving money from A to B. They are a core part of how customers experience trust, speed, and financial control every day. As a Data Director in Payments, you would help shape seamless local payment experiences, ensuring customers can pay and get paid reliably while continuing to modernise the infrastructure that powers millions of transactions behind the scenes.</p> <p>The role also sits at the intersection of Monzo’s broader ambition to build truly borderless banking and expand into new markets. That means designing products and payment capabilities that work effortlessly across geographies, currencies, and customer needs, while helping Monzo scale into new markets with the same simplicity and transparency that defines the brand today.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Design to help shape Monzo’s payments strategy to make Monzo's global ambitions a reality, enabling revenue and customer growth with a resilient, self-serve banking platform. </p> <p>To succeed, you should be excited about solving tough, ambiguous business problems with analytical rigour, commercial viability and execution effectiveness<br><br></p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day </strong></p> <ul> <li>Establish yourself as a trusted member of the Payments Leadership team, enabling better decisions across Payments and the wider Data Discipline</li> <li>Co-drive Payments strategy and product decisions with Product and Engineering, bringing Data into discovery early to shape priorities and challenge thinking</li> <li>Identify untapped opportunities for commercial optimisation, including across pricing, commercialisation, investment and customer growth</li> <li>Set the data strategy for Payments, including the operating model, team priorities, architecture, technical debt and key metrics and drivers</li> <li>Translate between technical, product and commercial perspectives to help teams make clear, high-impact decisions</li> <li>Develop and scale a high-performing team of data professionals sharing accountability for product and business outcomes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <p>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</p> <ul> <li>You have experience driving payments innovation and product strategy forward in a fast-growing business</li> <li>You combine deep Data expertise with strong product and commercial judgement. </li> <li>You can move comfortably from detailed metrics or architecture discussions to customer strategy, pricing and business outcomes</li> <li>You are an empathetic people leader who can build trust quickly, raise the performance bar and retain excellent talent</li> <li>You have experience growing and leading a full stack data team, including individual contributors and managers across Data Science, Analytics Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering and Analytics</li> <li>You have experience collaborating with senior cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing and risk/control functions</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>The Interview Process</strong></p> <p>After an informal ~30 min recruiter call, our interview process involves 2 main stages. You can have this all in one day or split these across multiple days, whichever your prefer.</li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on tech-hiring@monzo.com</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working : </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">📍London or Remote (UK) |<strong> 💰 </strong>Base salary for this role is £112,000 - £145,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +</span> <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> <br></span></p> <p><strong>Engineering Management at Monzo:</strong></p> <p>Engineering Managers at Monzo are part of cross-functional, autonomous teams and groups. Our teams are mission driven, and typically include Product Managers, backend, web and mobile engineers as well as data scientists, designers and subject matter experts relevant to that mission. Teams are organised into groups, and then collectives - we aim to keep our line management structure as shallow as possible, and for teams to directly own decision making relevant to their work.</p> <p>The Engineering Manager role at Monzo is split into three pillars - people, product, and technical leadership. Engineering Managers are accountable for the technical and delivery outcomes for their area - that means supporting and developing best in class engineering talent, as well as creating an inclusive team environment for people to do their best work.</p> <p>You can read more on the expectations of Engineering Managers on our <a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-manager-framework-v2-0.pdf" target="_blank">Progression Framework</a>.</p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>We're continuously hiring Engineering Managers as we continue to grow and build new teams. We hire on a pipeline based approach which means your application will be considered across all of our open EM positions. We use the interview process to assess your strengths and we'll match you to a role that best aligns with your experience. Of course, this is a collaborative process so you can also tell us which roles you're most interested in as you progress through interviews 😊 We're currently hiring across Platform, Core App, and Expansion.</p> <p><strong>You’ll spend your time:</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Taking accountability for delivery across your squad(s), collaborating with the Technical Lead and Product Manager.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Actively fostering a high bar for engineering excellence within your teams. You’re accountable for the technical outcomes your teams deliver alongside individual engineer performance and growth, so holding a high bar (and clearly articulating your expectations) is key.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You’ll initially lead a group of around 7-10 engineers (depending on the role) and support, coach and develop them through their career with regular 1:1s and continuous feedback.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Partner with senior engineers in your area to drive technical initiatives that raise the bar for our engineering practices.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Lead on communication with stakeholders from other teams, creating focus space for engineers to do their best work.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Collaborate with the wider engineering organisation to contribute to company-wide best managerial and technical practices and standards.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">While this is not a role which requires hands-on-coding, we are looking for an experienced manager who has a strong technical and delivery background and </span><strong>has worked as a software engineer in previous roles.</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We recognise that engineering managers lead in different ways, we’re looking for someone who: </span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Is comfortable operating with ambiguous problem areas with a high degree of autonomy.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">It’s a bonus if you have experience working in an experimentation led environment.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Has delivery experience and is able to guide the squads in achieving their outcomes.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Focuses on outcomes over processes, who optimises for the highest impact and leverage.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Is able to input, understand and challenge engineering decisions - but to empower the team to make those decisions themselves</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Has an understanding of what good looks like for a high-performing team of engineers and ability to chart a course to get there</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Is able to to coach people to achieve their goals</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Has a natural ability to inspire and motivate a team</span></li> </ul> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">We consider your application across all open EM roles at Monzo independent of which role you've applied for, so </span></em><strong><em>if you've recently applied to a similar role at Monzo and have been unsuccessful, please wait 6 months before applying again.<br><br></em></strong></p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working : </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. </p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</p> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <p>After an initial informal 30 min recruiting call, our interview process involves two main stages:</p> <ol> <li><strong>Initial Call Interview (1 hour)</strong> You'll meet with one of our Senior Engineering Managers or Engineering Directors. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They’ll ask example based questions (‘Tell me about a time when…’)<br><br></li> <li><strong>Loop Stage (3 hours 30 mins)</strong> The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability) and one 30 minute reverse interview (more details below).</li> </ol> <p>The Loop is one stage, and the interviews in the Loop are:</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;"><em>- Team and Org Management (1 hour)</em> <br>An example based interview with 1-2 of our engineering leaders. They’re interested to hear examples from your previous experience on the teams you’ve led, how you’ve shaped and partnered with product, and the impact you had.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;"><em>- System Design (1 hour)</em> <br>You'll partner with a Staff or Principal Engineer on a technical whiteboarding exercise.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;"><em>- Behavioural (1 hour)</em> <br>Similar to Team and Org Management, this is an example based interview with 1-2 Engineering Leaders. This interview focuses on your people leadership style and core behaviours as an Engineering Manager.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;"><em>- Chat with an Engineering Leader (30 mins)</em> <br>At Monzo, we believe interviews are a two-way street. This will be your opportunity to ask us any questions about Monzo, engineering leadership or our teams – whatever’s on your mind. </p> <p>All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You'll have the opportunity to super charge our user engagement in 2026 and help us to build a bank that customers truly love.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Monzo, we're building a bank that is fair, transparent and a delight to use. We’re growing extremely fast and have over 11 million customers in the UK. We’ve built a product that people love and more than 80% of our growth comes from word of mouth and referrals.</span></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Enable Monzo to Make Better Decisions, Faster</span></em></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. And we're great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker which gives data scientists the head space to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>How we hire</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are excited to be expanding and are hiring for multiple roles across our Data Science teams! While we allocate teams after the interview process, we aim to match your skills and aspirations with the most suitable role. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process.</p> <p>One of our recruiters has written a blog on the process, for extra details, hints and tips please see<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/2022/03/21/data-hiring-at-monzo"> Data Hiring at Monzo</a></p> <h4><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></h4> <p><strong>💰 </strong>£95,000 to £130,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK or Spain</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">✅ We can sponsor visas </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">📍This role can be based in our London or Barcelona offices, but we're also open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">📚</span><span style="font-weight: 400;">Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">➕And much more, see our full list of benefits </span><a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"><strong>here</strong></a></p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-NB2 #LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. title: Lead Machine Learning Scientist, Business Banking
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. Monzo Business Banking is fast-growing, is the UK’s most recommended business account for overall service quality. We recently hit 1 million customers and are used by 1 in 6 UK SMEs.</p> <p>We want to help businesses spend less time on financial admin and more time focused on running and growing their business. We’re building intelligent, data-driven and AI/ML-enabled product experiences that help small businesses feel more in control, make better decisions, and get more value from Monzo.</p> <p>ML is at the core of how we build and scale our products, enabling Monzo to make better decisions, faster, and helping us serve businesses more effectively.</p> <p>As a Lead Machine Learning Scientist in Business Banking, you’ll help build and ship models that power the next generation of Business Banking experiences. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Research, Data Science and Analytics Engineering to bring ML-enabled product capability into the heart of how we build for businesses.</p> <p>Whether it’s helping businesses understand their cash flow, reducing manual admin, surfacing the right insight at the right moment, or helping teams build intelligent product experiences responsibly, our work makes business banking smarter, simpler and more useful for SMEs.</p> <p> </p> <h1>What you'll be working on</h1> <p>As a Lead Machine Learning Scientist, you’ll be a technical leader and hands-on individual contributor, spearheading our ML and GenAI capabilities and shipping key models that powers magical Business Banking experiences.</p> <p>You’ll:</p> <ul> <li>Be one of the first ML Scientists in Business Banking, bringing leadership through ambiguity by adding structure and direction to our ML capabilities while staying agile and building momentum.</li> <li>Develop and deploy advanced ML models on our cloud-native data platform to serve hundreds of thousands of business customers.</li> <li>Partner with Product, data science and other stakeholders to identify the highest-impact opportunities, size impact, and define success metrics.</li> <li>Decide when to use ML, GenAI, or simpler approaches and be clear on trade-offs.</li> <li>Design robust evaluation and monitoring so we can ship responsibly and measure impact in production.</li> <li>Lead the design and implementation of batch and near-real-time models (e.g. LLM-powered experiences, predictive models, time-series forecasting).</li> <li>Collaborate closely with MLOps and Backend Engineering to operationalise models end-to-end and raise the bar on ML lifecycle rigor.</li> <li>Set technical standards, mentor others, and support experimentation and iteration.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h1>You should apply if</h1> <p>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</p> <ul> <li>You have a multiple year track record of excellence leading the development and deployment of advanced Machine Learning models to tackle real business problems, preferably in a fast-moving tech company.</li> <li>You have experience developing and shipping state-of-the-art ML models to production and delivering business impact.</li> <li>You're impact-driven and excited to own the end-to-end journey that starts with a business problem and ends with your solution having a measurable impact in production.</li> <li>You have a self-starter mindset; you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so.</li> <li>You speak Python fluently and have extensive, hands-on experience with <code>scikit-learn</code>. You are comfortable using SQL, and keen to learn Go, which is used in many of our backend microservices.</li> <li>You’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity and have experience helping your team and stakeholders resolve that ambiguity.</li> <li>You want to be involved in building a product that small businesses use to run and manage their financial lives every day.</li> <li>You have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions.</li> <li>You’re excited about fast-moving developments in Machine Learning and AI and can communicate those ideas to colleagues who are not familiar with the domain.</li> <li>You’re adaptable, curious and enjoy learning new technologies and ideas.</li> <li>You’re excited by the opportunity to help Business Banking evolve into AI and ML-enabled product capability.</li> <li>You can work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Research and Data colleagues to shape product strategy, clarify trade-offs and build things that customers actually use.</li> <li>You’re thoughtful about responsible ML/AI; especially in financial products where trust, transparency and customer control matter.</li> </ul> <h1>Nice to haves</h1> <ul> <li>Experience working on personalisation, ranking, recommendation, forecasting, classification or decisioning problems for customer-facing applications.</li> <li>Experience working on ML systems for fintech, banking, accounting, payments, lending, invoicing, cash flow, tax, risk or business software.</li> <li>Experience with GenAI, LLMs, agentic workflows, retrieval, evaluation frameworks, or human-in-the-loop product experiences.</li> <li>Commercial experience writing critical production code and working with microservices.</li> <li>Experience designing experiments, A/B tests or other approaches to measure product and customer impact.</li> <li>Experience working in regulated environments or with products where explainability, auditability and customer trust are especially important.</li> </ul> <h1>The interview process</h1> <p>Our interview process involves 3 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions!</p> <p>30 minute recruiter call</p> <p>45 minute call with hiring manager</p> <p>Full Loop: ML Modelling Interview, Product & ML interview, Behavioural Interview, Leadership interview</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on <a href="mailto:tech-hiring@monzo.com">tech-hiring@monzo.com</a>. Please also use that email to let us know if there's anything we can do to make your application process easier for you, because of disability, neurodiversity or any other personal reason.</p> <h1>What’s in it for you</h1> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">here</a></p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance</p> <p>#LI-REMOTE #LI-SR1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or UK Remote | 💰<a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-progression-framework-v4-0.pdf"> Senior Engineer (L50)</a> £105,000 - £135,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> | <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/technology">Technology</a> - Engineering  </p> <p><strong>About our Engineering Teams:</strong></p> <p>We have around 650 engineers across Monzo who design and build our in-house banking platform. We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company.</p> <p>These range from the products our customers use everyday to underlying infrastructure, security, payments and finance, customer operations, financial crime, and data, to name just a few areas. As a bank, there is scope for impact across a huge number of opportunities.</p> <p>We contribute to <a href="https://github.com/monzo"><strong>open source software</strong></a> as much as possible. Our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/technology"><strong>blog</strong></a><strong> </strong>is a good place to learn even more about what we do!</p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day   </strong></p> <p>This role is all about collaborating with your team to make a difference to your customers. As a backend engineer you’ll work in a squad alongside other disciplines like product managers, marketers, user researchers, designers, mobile engineers, web engineers, data analysts, business analysts, writers and more! </p> <p>Together you'll build and support a particular part of Monzo. Our squads belong to our wider collectives (a word we use to describe self-governing business units of ~100 people). They are: Core Banking, Business Banking, Wealth, Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Platform, Fincrime, Security & Expansion. All of our collectives are doing innovative work, many of which have machine learning and AI at the forefront- from fighting financial crime to building smarter financial tools - and you may have the opportunity to join a collective that gives you direct exposure to this exciting space.</p> <p>They’re all looking for additional Backend Engineers right now, we do a standard interview process across all our collectives and at the end we will find the best match for you based on your skills, experience, preferences and aligning with the business need! </p> <p>Our backend engineers have a variety of different backgrounds. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you. We do not ask for formal qualifications or degree requirements for any of our engineering roles.</p> <p><strong>How we work 💻</strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. We value meeting in person but we don't have a mandated requirement on office attendance, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️</p> <p>Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life:</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.</p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency 🕣✨</p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.</p> <p><strong>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</strong></p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product</li> <li>you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day</li> <li>you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions</li> <li>you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity</li> <li>you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software</li> <li>you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.).</li> <li>you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing</li> </ul> <p>We're on the look out for L50 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-progression-framework-v4-1.pdf">Engineering Progression Framework </a>- we will interview you across the whole frame work, so if you are not sure what level you are aiming for please chat to your recruiters! </p> <p><em>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything thats listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</em></p> <p><strong>What you’ll be working on: </strong></p> <p>We hire very technically agnostic so whilst we use the below technologies we do not expect prior knowledge, you will be fully supported in our organised onboarding to get up to speed in the below: </p> <ul> <li><a href="http://golang.org/"><strong>Go</strong></a> to write our application code (there’s an excellent interactive Go tutorial <a href="https://tour.golang.org/welcome/1"><strong>here</strong></a>)</li> <li><a href="http://cassandra.apache.org/"><strong>Cassandra</strong></a> for most persistent data storage</li> <li><a href="http://kafka.apache.org/"><strong>Kafka</strong></a> for our asynchronous message queue</li> <li><a href="http://kubernetes.io/"><strong>Kubernetes</strong></a> and <a href="https://www.docker.com/"><strong>Docker</strong></a> to schedule and run our services </li> <li><a href="https://www.envoyproxy.io/"><strong>Envoy Proxy</strong></a> for RPC</li> <li><a href="http://aws.amazon.com/"><strong>AWS</strong></a> for most of our production infrastructure and<a href="https://cloud.google.com/"> <strong>GCP</strong></a> for most of our data infrastructure</li> <li>React for our public web apps and internal tools</li> <li>We also have physical datacenters with actual cables to connect to various third parties</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Interview Process:</strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves three main stages: </p> <ol> <li>Initial Call </li> <li>Take home task or pair coding exercise </li> <li>Final interview: including a system design and a behavioural interview </li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. </p> <p>One of our engineers has written a detailed blog on their experience through this process, for extra details, hints and tips please see <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/2022/03/23/demystifying-the-backend-engineering-interview-process"><strong>here</strong></a>.</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰 £105,000 - £135,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>✈️We can help you relocate to the UK </p> <p>✅We can sponsor visas.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"><strong>here </strong></a></p> <p> </p> <p><em>We're usually always hiring for Backend Engineers, so there's no closing date for this job.</em></p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> Your direct reports will include Tech Leads, Senior Engineers and 2-3 Engineering Managers.<br><br>Senior Engineering Managers at Monzo are part of cross-functional, autonomous teams and groups. Our teams are mission driven, and typically include Product Managers, backend, web and mobile engineers as well as data scientists, designers and subject matter experts relevant to that mission. Teams are organised into groups, and then collectives - we aim to keep our line management structure as shallow as possible, and for teams to directly own decision making relevant to their work.</p> <p>Senior Engineering Managers are accountable for the technical and delivery outcomes for their area - that means supporting and developing best in class engineering talent, as well as creating an inclusive team environment for people to do their best work. You’ll be responsible for structuring, organising, supporting and challenging your team to deliver on their mission.</p> <p>You can read more on the expectations of Senior Engineering Managers in our <a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-manager-framework-v2-0.pdf">Progression Framework</a>.</p> <p><strong>Is this role right for you?</strong></p> <p>While this is not a role which requires hands-on-coding, we are looking for an experienced manager who has a strong technical and delivery background and has worked as a software engineer in previous roles.</p> <p>We recognise that Senior Engineering Managers lead in different ways, we’re looking for someone who is adept at: </p> <ul> <li><strong>Delivery and Execution</strong>: Enjoys taking accountability for delivery across your squad(s), collaborating with the Technical Lead and Product Manager.</li> <li><strong>Engineering and Operational Excellence</strong>: Actively fosters a high bar for engineering excellence within your teams. You’re accountable for the technical outcomes your teams deliver alongside individual engineer performance and growth, so holding a high bar (and clearly articulating your expectations) is key.</li> <li><strong>People Leadership:</strong> Has experience directly managing at least 2-3 Engineering Managers and leading orgs of around ~20 engineers. You can support, coach and develop them through their career with regular 1:1s and continuous feedback.</li> <li><strong>Technical Influence:</strong> Partners with senior engineers to drive technical initiatives that raise the bar for our engineering practices.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Relationships:</strong> Builds strong stakeholder relationships with other teams, and creates a focus space for engineers to do their best work.</li> <li><strong>Organisational Wide Impact:</strong> Collaborates with the wider engineering organisation to contribute to company-wide best managerial and technical practices and standards.</li> </ul> <p><em>We consider your application across all open EM roles at Monzo independent of which role you've applied for, so </em><strong><em>if you've recently applied to a similar role at Monzo and have been unsuccessful, please wait 6 months before applying again.<br><br></em></strong></p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working : </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. </p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</p> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <p>After an initial informal recruiter call you go through two main stages</p> <ol> <li><strong>Initial Call (1 hour)</strong> You'll meet with one of our Senior Engineering Managers or Engineering Directors. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They’ll ask example based questions (‘Tell me about a time when…’)<br><br></li> <li><strong>Loop Stage (3 hours 30 mins)</strong> The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability) and one 30 minute reverse interview (more details below).</li> </ol> <p>The Loop is one stage and the interviews in this stage are:</p> <p><em>- Team and Org Management (1 hour)</em><em><br></em>An example based interview with 1-2 of our engineering leaders. They’re interested to hear examples from your previous experience on the teams you’ve led, how you’ve shaped and partnered with product, and the impact you had.</p> <p><em>- System Design (1 hour)</em><em><br></em>You'll partner with a Staff or Principal Engineer on a technical whiteboarding exercise.</p> <p><em>- Behavioural (1 hour)</em><em><br></em>Similar to Team and Org Management, this is an example based interview with 1-2 Engineering Leaders. digital assets and emerging financial technologies will be your primary focus, more broadly, you will also have opportunities to work within a team of product lawyers to give first rate legal advice lawyers, product managers and engineers to provide legal advice and commercial insights to develop and grow Monzo Bank in the UK - and internationally. </li> </ul> <p>In particular, you will: </p> requirements for Monzo. </li> <li>Help to develop efficient ways of working to enable Monzo to scale quickly, and ensuring Monzo operates safely and in accordance with the law and regulation.</li> <li>Provide training and knowledge sharing with other Monzonauts on the impact of laws and regulations for Monzo and our customers in your specialist area..</li> <li>Often act as the sole lawyer advising product managers or other colleagues, identifying legal issues proactively, evaluating relevant risks and finding effective solutions to unique and complex business activities. </li> <li>You’ll work closely and collaboratively with Monzo’s Director of Legal for Payments & Business Banking, Director of Product Legal, the General Counsel of Monzo Bank Limited and the other members of the UK Legal team to provide legal advice and commercial insights, in particular in relation to digital assets and other emerging financial technologies, to Product teams.</li> <li>You’ll be a trusted advisor and will work proactively and collaboratively with other relevant stakeholders and teams across the Monzo Group, including the Product, Risk & Compliance, Supplier Operations, Financial Crime, Fraud and Operations teams.</li> <li>You’ll advise on the evolving legal and regulatory framework for digital assets and emerging financial technologies, working with colleagues across the UK and EU to  to help us identify relevant local legal and regulatory requirements and apply them to our products.</li> <li>You’ll work with colleagues across the Legal and Board Governance Collective to improve the management of our teams’ activities, including through identifying suitable technology solutions to streamline workflows, optimise processes and efficiencies, and increase scalability.</li> <li>You’ll proactively manage relationships with external suppliers and law firms to enhance processes around cost management to ensure we are optimising our spend and extracting best value while delivering top-quality legal support. </li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are a technically excellent lawyer with a minimum of 5 years of You are excited to work in a fast-paced environment and to join us for the next stage of our journey at Monzo!</li> </ul> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves 3 main stages: </p> <ul> <li>Recruiter call</li> <li>Initial call </li> <li>Full loop: Technical and behavioural interviews </li> </ul> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. </p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰 circa £110,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance ➕ benefits </p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>📍This role is based in our London office. If you are not based in London, we're open to discuss this on a case by case basis.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕ And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"><strong>here </strong></a></p> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰£80,000 - £105,000 +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a> |</p> <p><strong>About Business Banking at Monzo</strong></p> <p>Since its launch five years ago, Monzo Business Banking has been dedicated to delivering the very best of Monzo to small businesses. Today, it's an award-winning service, empowering over 1 million businesses across the UK. </p> <p>As Monzo expands across Europe, Business Banking is entering its next phase: adapting our products and proposition for small businesses in new markets, while continuing our mission to make money work for businesses.</p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for <em>several</em><strong> Senior PMMs </strong>to own Product Marketing for entire products and experiences. </p> <p>A useful distinction - at Monzo, Product Marketing starts upstream in product-market fit. We're embedded in squads with Product Managers, Data Scientists, Designers, User Researchers, and Sales, bringing the voice of the customer and market into what we build, how we position it, and how we take it to market. We own customer and market understanding, positioning, proposition, launch strategy, and sales enablement. We then partner closely with Integrated Marketing, who lead campaign strategy, creative direction, channel execution, and growth. Together, we build the right products and help them succeed in market.</p> <p><strong>This is a senior individual contributor role.</strong> You'll own Product Marketing for a product end-to-end: understanding customers, shaping product strategy, defining positioning, and helping bring launches to market.</p> <p><strong>Where you could join</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Business Banking EU. </strong>Business Banking is entering its next phase of growth as we expand beyond the UK. In this role, you'll define how Monzo Business Banking succeeds in new European markets - understanding local customer needs, building the proposition that translates our core product into local relevance, and working across Product, Growth, Marketing, and local teams to bring those products to market. This is a senior role for someone with high autonomy who loves turning dense customer and market insight into practical decisions about what should launch.</li> <li><strong>Business Banking</strong><strong>. </strong>Business Banking is growing quickly, serving more than one million businesses across the UK while expanding into increasingly sophisticated customer needs. In this role, you'll shape how our products are positioned, sold, and adopted—from defining compelling product narratives to enabling Sales and partnering with Growth and Marketing on launches. This is a role for someone who enjoys sitting at the intersection of Product and commercial teams, translating customer insight into positioning, propositions, and go-to-market strategies that help more businesses choose Monzo.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Set Product Marketing Strategy for a set of products. </strong>You'll define a one-year Product Marketing strategy for a major area of Business Banking, connecting customer insight, market opportunity, and commercial priorities into a clear direction for the product area, rather than one individual product, with measurable business outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Develop differentiated positioning & messaging: </strong>You'll create compelling positioning, messaging, and value propositions that differentiate Monzo in the market and resonate with different customer segments. You'll build messaging frameworks that Product, Sales, Integrated Marketing, and broader marketing teams use consistently across launches and customer journeys.</li> <li><strong>Drive competitive intelligence and market insights</strong>: You’ll build and maintain the market view for your product area. You'll become the recognised authority on your customer segment and competitive landscape, building a coherent view of the market from customer research, commercial data, competitor intelligence, and Sales insight. Your recommendations will shape product strategy, positioning, go-to-market, and commercial priorities across the Business Banking collective.</li> <li><strong>Shape product strategy across markets.</strong> You'll partner closely with Product, Research, Design, and Data to identify customer problems, market opportunities, and competitive gaps that influence roadmap priorities. Your customer and market insight will shape what we build, not just how we bring it to market.</li> <li><strong>Set the go-to-market strategy for priority products and markets</strong>. You'll define what audiences we prioritise, why they would choose Monzo, what needs to be true for them to switch and stay, and what success looks like - giving Product, Sales, Marketing, and local market teams a shared strategic direction for how the product enters or scales in market.</li> <li><strong>Own product representation across the customer journey.</strong> You'll define the core proposition and value messages that should carry through key customer and sales touchpoints, so customers consistently understand why the product matters. You'll partner with teams across Product, Sales, Marketing, CRM, and local markets to make sure the customer experience reflects the agreed positioning.</li> <li><strong>Enable localisation:</strong> You'll work with local market teams to determine what should remain globally consistent and what should adapt locally, ensuring positioning, customer journeys, and launches resonate in each market while strengthening the overall Monzo Business Banking proposition.</li> </ul> <p><strong>This is for you if: </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You're recognised for your Product Marketing expertise.</strong> You're comfortable owning Product Marketing across a product area or market, and people seek your perspective on customers, competitors, positioning, and product strategy.</li> <li><strong>You bring senior stakeholders with you & thrive in cross-functional environments. </strong>You work effectively across Product, Sales, Growth, Marketing, and Research, building alignment around difficult decisions and helping teams make confident product and commercial choices.</li> <li><strong>You raise the quality of the work around you.</strong> You enjoy mentoring less experienced PMMs, sharing your expertise, and improving how the team works through better frameworks, feedback, and knowledge sharing.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>The Interview Process</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves three main stages:</p> <ul> <li>Initial Call (45mins) </li> <li>Case Study Presentation (1hour)</li> <li>x2 final interviews via Google Meet (45mins for each interview)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>You’ll hear from us throughout the application process, but if you’ve got any questions, please reach out to hiring@monzo.com. You can also use this email address to let us know if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you because of disability, neurodiversity or anything else.</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you: </strong></p> <ul> <li>£80,000 - £105,000 as a base salary</li> <li>This role will be based out of our London office next to Liverpool Street station in a hybrid approach of office based and home working, or remotely within the UK </li> <li>We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</li> <li>Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences </li> <li>And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"><strong>here</strong><strong> </strong></a></li> </ul> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. <br><br>#LI-JB1 #LI-REMOTE</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer.
